pathya_apathya: Pathya: Mother's milk, light rice gruel (Laja Peya), boiled water. Apathya: Heavy cow/buffalo milk, cold food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 2 (p. 506); Chakradatta Balarogachikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Balarogadhikara
safety_check: Do not use honey in infants under 12 months (use expressed breast milk or warm water as vehicle instead)

condition_name: Sciatica, Lumbar Spondylosis & Radiating Leg Pain (Gridhrasi & Kati-Graha)
remedy_name: Nirgundi-Dashamoola Kwath & Lashuna Ksheerapaka (Garlic Milk)
remedy_text: 1) Lashuna Ksheerapaka: Boil 3-4 crushed cloves of Lahsun (garlic) in 100 ml milk and 400 ml water until reduced to 100 ml milk; strain and drink warm once daily in the morning or at bedtime. 2) Nirgundi-Dashamoola Kwath: Take 20 ml decoction of Dashamoola and Nirgundi (Vitex negundo) leaves with 5 ml Eranda Taila (castor oil) at bedtime.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 16, p. 415 & Ch. 23 Vatavyadhi Chikitsa) and Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa). Garlic cooked in milk (Ksheerapaka) buffers its तीक्ष्ण/उष्ण irritation while delivering potent Vatahara and nerve-soothing action along the sciatic nerve (Kandara).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, garlic, castor oil purgation (Mridu Virechana), Kati Basti / warm oil massage. Apathya: Lifting heavy weights, sitting on hard cold surfaces, chickpeas/peas.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 (p. 415) & Ch. 23; Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 15
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (Eranda Taila) and active Peptic Ulcer
keywords: lower back pain radiating to leg

condition_name: Physical & Sexual Debility, Fatigue & Tissue Depletion (Dhatukshaya & Klaibya)
remedy_name: Ashwagandha-Shatavari-Kapikacchu Ksheerapaka with Ghee & Madhu
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) root powder and/or Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) powder cooked in 150 ml warm milk with 1 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp sugar/misri twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 24, p. 144: 'Ashwagandhavidaryadya vrishyashchaushadhayo hitah' & Uttarasthana Ch. 50 Vajikarana, p. 733-738), Ashwagandha, Vidari, Shatavari, and Amalaki with milk and ghee are the premier Brimhana (tissue-building), Balya, and Vrishya Rasayanas.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, almonds, dates (Kharjura), black gram (Masha) soup, adequate sleep. Apathya: Excessive fasting, dry/bitter/astringent foods, mental anxiety.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 24 (p. 144) & Uttarasthana Ch. 50 (p. 733-738)
safety_check: Avoid high-dose Ashwagandha in Pregnancy; omit sugar in Diabetes

condition_name: Chronic Eczema, Psoriasis, Boils & Non-Healing Skin Lesions (Kushtha & Pidika)
remedy_name: Panchatikta Ghrita Guggulu / Khadirarishta & Aragwadhadi Kwath
remedy_text: 1) Decoction: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from Khadira bark (Acacia catechu), Nimba, Patola, Guduchi, Vasa, and Triphala; take twice daily. 2) Classical: Khadirarishta (15-20 ml with equal water after meals) or Panchatikta Ghrita (5-10 ml with warm water).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Khadirah kushthaghnanam' & Chikitsasthana Ch. 21 Kushtha Chikitsa, p. 433-438), Khadira is the supreme herb for all skin diseases (Kushtha), clearing deep Rakta-Mamsa-Meda vitiation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Old rice, Moong dal, bitter gourd, Neem, Triphala. Apathya: Milk with fish/salt/sour fruits (Viruddha Ahara), curd, urad dal, jaggery, sesame.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98) & Chikitsasthana Ch. 21 (p. 433-438)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy

condition_name: Prophylaxis Against Recurrent Common Cold (Pratishyaya Prevention)
remedy_name: Morning Adrak (Fresh Ginger) Decoction
remedy_text: Take 10 ml warm decoction prepared from a small piece of fresh ginger (Adrak) every morning on an empty stomach to prevent recurrent attacks of cold.
ayurvedic_note: Regular morning intake of Ardraka kindles Agni and prevents Kapha accumulation in the head and chest during seasonal transitions (Ritusandhi).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water bath, light breakfast. Apathya: Morning cold water exposure, curd.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 1 (Adrak/Sonth)
safety_check: Avoid in active Peptic Ulcer / severe Hyperacidity

condition_name: Subacute Cold & Cough with Sore Throat (Kapha-Vata Kasa)
remedy_name: Sonth-Guda (Dry Ginger & Jaggery) Bolus
remedy_text: Mix 2-5 gm powder of dry ginger (Sonth) with old Jaggery (Guda) and take thrice a day in divided doses.
ayurvedic_note: Guda softens the throat and binds the pungent Sunthi powder, providing sustained Kapha-Vata shamana and expectoration.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water. Apathya: Cold drinks, fried foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 1 (Adrak/Sonth)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Diabetes (Guda) and severe Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer (Sonth)

condition_name: Productive Cough with Thick Sputum (Kaphaja Kasa)
remedy_name: Lahsun (Garlic) Boiled Water with Sugar or Honey
remedy_text: Boil a crushed bulb/cloves of Lahsun (Allium sativum / Garlic) in water, strain, and take warm with a little sugar; OR take 6 ml fresh garlic juice mixed with honey twice a day.
ayurvedic_note: Rasona (garlic) has Tikshna, Ushna, and Kapha-chedana properties that cut through thick, sticky bronchial mucus in Kaphaja Kasa and asthma.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light food. Apathya: Cold dairy, sweets.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 15 (Lahsun)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer and Infants under 1 year (Honey)

condition_name: Chronic Pruritus, Eczema & Allergic Skin Conditions (Kandu & Kushtha)
remedy_name: Bhuna Jeera (Fried Cumin) with Warm Milk
remedy_text: Take 1-2 gm powder of fried Jeera (Cuminum cyminum) with warm milk twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Digestive Ama and Pitta-Kapha vitiation underlie many chronic skin allergies. Jiraka with milk corrects Agni while gently cooling Pitta in the Rakta Dhatu.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light, non-spicy diet. Apathya: Fermented, sour, salty foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 12 (Jeera)
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients including Pregnancy and Gastritis

condition_name: Anorexia & Loss of Appetite with Bloating (Vata-Kapha Aruchi)
remedy_name: Hing-Jeera Churna with Ghee
remedy_text: Mix a pinch of fried Hing (asafoetida) and 1 gm roasted Jeera (cumin) powder with 1 tsp Ghee (clarified butter) and take with warm food at the start of meals.
ayurvedic_note: Ghee stimulates Samana Vata and Pachaka Pitta without increasing dryness, while Hingu and Jiraka clear Kapha-Vata obstruction in the gut.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm rice/roti, moong dal. Apathya: Cold water with meals.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8 (Ghee)
safety_check: Avoid Hing in Pregnancy

condition_name: Chronic Indigestion, Flatulence & Sluggish Bowel (Mandagni)
remedy_name: Roasted Saunf-Kalimirach Takra (Spiced Fennel Buttermilk)
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm powder of roasted Saunf (fennel seeds) mixed in a glass of fresh buttermilk (Takra) with a little black pepper powder and rock salt twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Shatapushpa (Saunf) and Takra restore Agni, prevent post-meal drowsiness (Bhuktajadya), and clear intestinal gas.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Daytime buttermilk after lunch. Apathya: Curd at night.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 24 (Saunf)
safety_check: Omit salt in severe Hypertension

condition_name: Delirium, Drowsiness & Severe Toxic Fever (Sannipata Jwara — Emergency Adjunctive)
remedy_name: Bhunimbadi Ashtadashanga Kwath & Brihat Katphaladi Kwath
remedy_text: Classical hospital/Vaidya decoction prepared from Bhunimba (Kiratatikta), Devadaru, Dashamoola, Shunthi, Musta, Katuki, Indrayava, Dhanyaka, and Gajapippali (20 ml warm with Pippali powder). NOTE: Altered mental status, drowsiness, neck stiffness, or breathlessness in fever is a RED-TIER EMERGENCY requiring immediate hospital/108 transfer!
ayurvedic_note: Documented in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 146-151, p. 52-53) for Tridoshaja Sannipata fevers complicated by respiratory congestion, parotitis (Karnamoola Shotha), and stupor.
pathya_apathya: Immediate hospital referral required for Red-Tier Sannipata symptoms.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 146-151 (p. 52-53)
safety_check: RED-TIER WARNING: Any fever with stupor/delirium/breathlessness must be referred immediately to emergency care

condition_name: Chronic Low-Grade Fever with Cough, Night Sweats & Emaciation (Jirna Jwara & Kshaya)
remedy_name: Pippalyadi Ghrita &vasa-Guduchi Kwath
remedy_text: 1) Vasa-Guduchi Kwath: 20 ml decoction of Vasa, Guduchi, Triphala, Trayamana, and Yavasaka twice daily. 2) Pippalyadi Ghrita: Medicated cow's Ghee cooked with Pippali, Chandana, Musta, Ushira, Katuki, Kalingaka, Amalaki, Sariva, Ativisha, Sthira, Draksha, and Trayamana (5-10 gm with warm milk/water).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 2 Jirnajwara Chikitsa, p. 330: 'Dehadhatvabalatvena jwaro jirno anuvartate') and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 262-265, p. 81-82), chronic fever persists due to Dhatu depletion and Vata-Pitta dryness; medicated Ghritas (Sarpih-pana) and milk (Ksheera) nourish Dhatus and extinguish deep-seated fever.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, medicated ghee, old Shali rice, Moong soup. Apathya: Fasting (Langhana is contraindicated in Jirna/Kshaya Jwara!), dry/spicy food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 2 (p. 330); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 262-265 (p. 81-82)
safety_check: Note: Chronic fever >2 weeks with weight loss/night sweats requires PHC sputum/TB (Nikshay) screening!

condition_name: Chronic Colitis, Ulcerative Colitis & Mucoid Dysentery (Sangrahani & Raktatisara)
remedy_name: Kutajashtaka Avaleha / Brihat Kutajavaleha
remedy_text: Prepared by boiling 100 Palas of Kutaja bark in water down to 1/4th, straining, and cooking to a thick linctus (Avaleha) with powdered Patha, Samanga (Lajjalu), Ativisha, Musta, Bilva pulp, Dhataki flowers, Shalmali exudate (Mocharasa), and Kutaja seeds. Take 5-10 gm twice daily with buttermilk, goat's milk, or water.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 10, p. 385), Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara v. 83-86, p. 294), and Chakradatta (p. 34). Heals mucosal ulcerations in the colon, stops bleeding, and cures all types of Atisara, Grahani, and bleeding Arsha.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, rice gruel, pomegranate. Apathya: Spicy, sour, heavy foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 385); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara v. 83-86 (p. 294); Chakradatta (p. 34)
safety_check: Safe for chronic colitis and dysentery

condition_name: Rectal Prolapse, Tenesmus & Severe Dysentery Pain (Gudabhransha & Pravahika)
remedy_name: Bilvadi Yoga & Madhvadhi Yoga with Takra
remedy_text: Take equal parts of unripe Bilva pulp, Musta, Dhataki flowers, Patha, Shunthi, and Mocharasa (5 gm total) with buttermilk (Takra) and jaggery twice daily. For rectal prolapse (Gudabhransha), apply warm Bala Taila or Changeryadi Ghrita locally and perform gentle sitz bath.
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara v. 58 & 65-66, p. 287 & 289) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 11, p. 391). Relieves severe straining (Pravahana) and tones the pelvic floor and rectal sphincter.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Soft gruels, buttermilk, avoiding straining at stool. Apathya: Dry, hard foods, squatting for long periods.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara v. 58 & 65-66 (p. 287, 289); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 11 (p. 391)
safety_check: Seek medical evaluation at PHC if rectal prolapse is irreducible

condition_name: Chronic Malabsorption, Celiac/Sprue-like Diarrhoea & Edema (Grahani & Shotha)
remedy_name: Takrarishta (Classical Medicated Fermented Buttermilk)
remedy_text: Prepared by fermenting fresh buttermilk (Takra) with fine powders of Yavani (Ajvain), Amalaki, Haritaki, Maricha, and five Lavanas (or Hapusha, Dhanyaka, Jeeraka, Chitraka, Pippali, Shunthi) for 7-10 days until sour-pungent. Take 15-30 ml after meals twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 12 Grahani Chikitsa, p. 395: 'Esha takrarishtah param dipano arshogulmajatharashwayathukrimipramehaharah'), Bhaishajya Ratnavali (p. 325), and Chakradatta (p. 42). Rich in natural probiotics and Agni-deepana herbs, it cures Grahani, piles, edema, and worm infestations.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light rice and buttermilk diet. Apathya: Heavy milk products, fried food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 12 (p. 395); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Grahanyadhikara v. 152-153 (p. 325); Chakradatta (p. 42)
safety_check: Avoid in severe Hyperacidity/Ulcer and uncontrolled Hypertension (contains Lavana)

condition_name: Menopause Hot Flashes, Burning Sensation & Irritability (Rajonivritti Janya Daha)
remedy_name: Shatavari-Amalaki Ksheerapaka & Ushira-Chandana Hima
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) root powder and 2 gm Amla powder with a cup of warm or cool milk twice daily. For facial pigmentation (melasma), apply Jayphal rubbed in milk externally.
ayurvedic_note: Shatavari is Madhura, Sheeta, Rasayana, and balances the Vata-Pitta transition of Rajonivritti (menopause), relieving hot flashes (Daha), dryness, and irritability.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, pomegranate, Amla, coconut water, cooling pranayama (Sheetali). Apathya: Spicy, sour, hot foods, caffeine.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 7); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4 & 11
safety_check: 100% Safe for menopausal women

condition_name: Cervical Spondylosis, Shoulder Pain & Brachial Neuralgia (Manyastambha & Avabahuka)
remedy_name: Rasnasaptaka Kwath & Dashamoola-Bala Taila Abhyanga
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata), Guduchi, Aragwadha, Devadaru, Gokshura, Eranda moola, and Punarnava (Rasnasaptaka Kwath); take warm twice daily with 1/2 tsp ginger juice. 2) External: Gently massage neck and shoulder with warm Mahanarayana Taila or Bala Taila followed by warm dry fomentation (Ruksha/Nadi Sweda).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Rasna vataharanam') and Chikitsasthana Ch. 23, Rasna is declared the #1 Vata-pacifying herb in the entire Materia Medica.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Proper neck posture, warm water, garlic, gentle neck exercises. Apathya: High pillows (Uchcha-upadhana), cold wind exposure, suppressing sneeze/yawn urges.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98) & Chikitsasthana Ch. 23; Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa
safety_check: Safe across adult populations

condition_name: Mouth Ulcers & Stomatitis (Mukhapaka / Sarvasara Mukharoga)
remedy_name: Triphala-Madhu Kavala (Gargle), Mulethi-Ghee Lepa & Nariyal Pani
remedy_text: 1) Topical & Gargle: Gargle 3-4 times daily with a cooled decoction of Triphala or Jati (Jasmine) leaves or Anar rind mixed with 1 tsp Honey (Madhu), OR apply pure cow's Ghee / Honey directly over the mouth ulcers. 2) Internal: Drink tender coconut water (Nariyal pani) and take 3 gm Amla powder with milk at bedtime to clear Pitta from the gut.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 26 Mukharoga Pratishedha, p. 600: 'Mukhapakeshu samanyatas triphalakwatho madhuman'), Triphala Kwath with honey and Ghee rapidly heals Pittaja-Raktaja aphthous ulcers.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Bland, cooling diet, milk, ghee, coconut water. Apathya: Spicy chilies, hot tea/coffee, sour pickles, betel nut/tobacco.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 26 (p. 600); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 8, 17, 19
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients (avoid honey in infants <1 year)

condition_name: Dysuria, Burning Urination & Cystitis (Pittaja Mutrakricchra)
remedy_name: Trinapanchamoola Kwath / Shatavari-Gokshura-Amalaki Hima
remedy_text: Prepare a cold infusion or cooled decoction (20-30 ml) from equal parts of Gokshura, Shatavari, Amalaki, Ushira (Khus), and Dhania seeds with 1 tsp Misri (rock candy). Drink twice or thrice daily alongside tender coconut water.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 Mutraghata Chikitsa, p. 400). Alkalizes acidic urine, cools Pitta in the Mutravaha Srotas, and relieves burning micturition (Sadaha Mutrata).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Plenty of water, coconut water, cucumber, ash gourd, barley water. Apathya: Alcohol, spicy/sour/salty foods, holding urine.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 (p. 400); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 6, 19
safety_check: 100% Safe in Pregnancy, Hypertension, and Gastritis; omit Misri in Diabetes

condition_name: Thrombosed or Painful Swollen External Piles (Sashoola/Sashotha Arsha)
remedy_name: Haridra-Ghee / Kumari (Aloe Vera) External Lepa & Triphala Sitz Bath
remedy_text: 1) Sitz Bath (Avagaha Sweda): Sit in a tub of warm water mixed with Triphala decoction and a pinch of Tankana (borax) or rock salt for 10-15 minutes twice daily. 2) Local Paste: Apply a smooth paste of Haldi (turmeric) powder mixed with cow's Ghee (or fresh Aloe vera pulp) over the external pile mass after defecation.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 Arsha Chikitsa, p. 380) and Chakradatta (Arshachikitsa, p. 45). Warm Avagaha Sweda and Haridra-Ghrita Lepa relieve sphincter spasm, reduce venous engorgement, and soothe pain.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, fiber-rich diet, warm sitz bath. Apathya: Straining, sitting on hard seats, spicy food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 380); Chakradatta Arshachikitsa (p. 45); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8-9
safety_check: 100% Safe external therapy across all patients including Pregnancy
keywords: बवासीर के मस्से में सूजन और दर्द

condition_name: Hemicrania, Migraine & Sunrise-to-Sunset Headache (Ardhavabhedaka & Suryavarta)
remedy_name: Pathyadi Kwath & Goghrita / Anu Taila Pratimarsha Nasya
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction of Pathyadi Kwath — equal parts of Pathya (Haritaki), Vibhitaki, Amalaki, Bhunimba (Kiratatikta), Haridra (Turmeric), Nimba bark, and Guduchi (Giloy); take twice daily with a little jaggery or honey. 2) Nasal Instillation (Nasya): Instill 2 drops of lukewarm pure cow's Ghee (or Shadbindu/Anu Taila) into each nostril in the morning.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 27-28 Shiroroga Vijnaniya & Pratishedha, p. 602-605) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shirorogadhikara), Ardhavabhedaka (migraine) and Suryavarta (sinus/vascular headache peaking at noon) respond specifically to Pathyadi Kwath and Sneha Nasya ('Nasa hi shiraso dwaram' — the nose is the gateway to the head).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Regular meals, cow's ghee, milk, pomegranate, adequate sleep. Apathya: Fasting/skipping meals, bright sun exposure, fermented/sour foods, night vigil.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 28 (p. 604-605); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Shirorogadhikara
safety_check: Avoid oral Haritaki in Pregnancy (use Ghee Nasya and Amla-Takra forehead paste instead)

condition_name: Post-Viral Arthralgia & Chikungunya/Dengue Recovery Joint Pain (Sandhigata Jwara)
remedy_name: Guduchi-Rasnadi Kwath (Giloy, Rasna, Eranda, Devadaru & Ginger Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from equal parts of Guduchi (Giloy), Rasna, Shunthi (dry ginger), Devadaru, and Dashamoola. Take warm twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 104-107, p. 42) and Ashtanga Sangraha. Clears residual Jwara-Ama lodged in the joints (Parvabheda/Sandhishoola) and restores joint mobility.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light soups, rest. Apathya: Cold water, sour curds, heavy beans.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 104-107 (p. 42)
safety_check: Safe across adult groups
keywords: बुखार के बाद जोड़ों का दर्द

condition_name: Chronic Allergic Rhinitis, Urticaria & Recurrent Skin Allergy (Shitapitta & Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Haridra Khanda (Classical Turmeric Anti-Allergic Granules)
remedy_text: Classical granule formulation prepared from Haridra (Turmeric - 8 parts), cow's Ghee (6 parts), cow's Milk, Sugar, and fine powders of Trikatu, Trijata, Vidanga, Trivrit, Triphala, Nagakesara, Musta, and Lauha Bhasma. Take 3-5 gm twice daily with warm milk.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shitapitta-Udarda-Kothadhikara) as the premier classical formulation for chronic urticaria (Shitapitta), pruritus (Kandu), allergic rhinitis, and fungal skin infections (Dadru).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm milk, light wholesome diet. Apathya: Cold wind/water, incompatible foods, fish, curd.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Shitapitta-Udarda-Kothadhikara; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 9 (Haldi)
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains Sharkara) and Pregnancy (contains Trivrit)

condition_name: Fatty Liver, Hepatomegaly, Splenomegaly & Ascites Support (Yakrit-Pliha Vriddhi)
remedy_name: Rohitakarishta /Rohitakadi Kwath & Pippali-Haritaki Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Pippali-Haritaki Yoga: Take 1-2 gm equal parts of Pippali and Haritaki powder with a little old jaggery (Guda) or warm water twice daily. 2) Classical: Rohitakarishta (prepared from Rohitaka bark, Triphala, Trikatu, Trijata, Chavya, Chitraka) 15-20 ml with equal water after meals.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 17 Udara Chikitsa, p. 422) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Rohitaka and Pippali-Haritaki clear Kapha-Pitta congestion in the liver (Yakrit) and spleen (Pliha).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, old barley/rice, light diet. Apathya: Alcohol, heavy fats, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 17 (p. 422); Chakradatta Plihayakrillikitsa
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy

condition_name: Spasmodic Abdominal Colic, Renal Colic & Bloating (Shoola & Gulma)
remedy_name: Lavanabhaskara Churna (Classical Carminative & Digestive Salt Formula)
remedy_text: Composed of Samudra Lavana, Sauvarchala Lavana, Vida Lavana, Saindhava Lavana, Dhanyaka, Pippali, Pippalimoola, Krishna Jeeraka, Nagakesara, Talisa, Amlavetasa, Maricha, Jeeraka, Shunthi, Dadima (pomegranate seeds), Tvak, and Ela. Take 2-3 gm with buttermilk or warm water after meals.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Grahanychikitsa / Shoolachikitsa) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali. Rapidly relieves Vata-Kapha abdominal colic, splenic pain, bloating, constipation, and indigestion.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, warm water. Apathya: Cold, dry, heavy legumes.
source: Chakradatta Grahanychikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN HYPERTENSION (High Sodium/Lavana content) and Hyperacidity/Ulcer

condition_name: Bone Fracture Healing, Osteoporosis & Ligament Sprain (Asthibhanga & Asthikshaya)
remedy_name: Asthishrinkhala (Hadjod) & Arjuna-Laksha Ksheerapaka with Ghee
remedy_text: Take 3 gm powder of Asthishrinkhala (Cissus quadrangularis / Hadjod) stem or Arjuna bark with 1 tsp cow's Ghee in a cup of warm milk twice daily. Also include garlic (Lahsun) paste with honey/food to accelerate bone union (Sandhanakara).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 7, p. 55: 'Bhagnasandhanakrit... lashunah' & Uttarasthana Ch. 32 Bhagna Pratishedha, p. 625), Lashuna, Arjuna, Laksha, and Madhura-Snigdha milk/ghee promote rapid callus formation (Asthi-sandhana).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, wheat, Shali rice, meat soup/moong soup, rest/immobilization. Apathya: Salt, sour, pungent, dry foods, physical strain on injured limb.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 7 (p. 55) & Uttarasthana Ch. 32 (p. 625-627); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 170-171 (p. 58-59: Asthikarkata/Hadjod)
safety_check: Always ensure proper orthopedic splinting/X-ray at PHC for suspected fractures!

condition_name: Night Blindness, Dry Eyes & Progressive Vision Weakness (Naktandhya, Shushkakshipaka & Timira)
remedy_name: Jeevanti-Agastya Patra Ghrita & Mahatraiphala Ghrita
remedy_text: 1) Dietary Remedy: Cook fresh Jeevanti (Leptadenia reticulata) leaves or Agastya leaves/flowers or Moringa (Shigru) leaves in cow's Ghee and include in daily meals; take 3-5 gm Triphala Churna with Ghee and Honey at night. 2) Classical: Mahatraiphala Ghrita (5 ml with warm milk at bedtime).
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 16 Timira Pratishedha, p. 558 & 561: 'Jivantyah pallavani cha bhakshayet'). Rich in natural beta-carotene (Vitamin A) and Chakshushya lipids, curing night blindness (Naktandhya) and dry eye syndrome.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cow's ghee, Triphala, Jeevanti, Amla, green leafy vegetables, foot massage with ghee. Apathya: Sour foods, night vigil, smoke/dust.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 16 (p. 558, 561); Chakradatta Netrarogachikitsa
safety_check: Avoid oral Triphala in Pregnancy; dietary Jeevanti/Ghee is 100% safe

condition_name: Infant/Child Abdominal Colic & Gas Distension (Bala Udara Shoola & Adhmana)
remedy_name: External Hing (Asafoetida) Warm Navel Paste (Nabhi Lepa)
remedy_text: Take a pinch of Hing (Ferula narthex / Asafoetida), stir and dissolve in a teaspoon of warm water to make a thin paste, and apply externally on and around the child's umbilicus (navel) in a circular motion.
ayurvedic_note: Specifically highlighted in CCRAS Ayurvedic Home Remedies (p. 10: 'Specially in children or infants where there is abdominal distention this is very helpful') and Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 2). Transdermal absorption around the Nabhi (seat of Samana Vata and Agni) relieves infantile colic without oral irritation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Gentle clockwise tummy massage, burping baby after feeds. Apathya: Mother consuming gas-forming foods (chana, rajma, cold water) while breastfeeding.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 10 (Hing); Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 2
safety_check: 100% Safe external application for infants and children of all ages

condition_name: Common Cold with Body Ache & Chills (Vata-Kapha Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Dhania-Haldi-Sharkara Warm Decoction (Coriander-Turmeric Tea)
remedy_text: Prepare 20 ml warm decoction from 5 gm coarse powder of Dhania (coriander seeds) mixed with a pinch of Haldi (turmeric) powder and a little sugar thrice a day. Regular morning intake of Dhania herbal tea prevents recurrent cold, cough, and digestive upsets.
ayurvedic_note: Dhanyaka is Tridoshahara, Deepana, and Srotoshodhana, clearing Kapha-Vata congestion in the respiratory channels without increasing Pitta heat.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Lukewarm water, light warm meals. Apathya: Cold water, curd, refrigerated foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS, Govt. of India), p. 6 (Dhania)
safety_check: Omit sugar in Diabetes; 100% safe in Hypertension, Pregnancy, and Gastritis

condition_name: Allergic Cold, Coryza & Nasal Congestion (Kaphaja Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Dhania-Methi-Haldi Kwath (Coriander-Fenugreek-Turmeric Decoction)
remedy_text: Boil 5 gm Dhania (coriander seeds), 1 gm Methi (fenugreek) seeds, and a pinch of Haldi (turmeric) powder in 80 ml water until reduced to 20 ml. Strain and drink warm 2-3 times a day.
ayurvedic_note: Methika and Haridra dry up excessive watery nasal discharge (Nasa-srava) and reduce mucosal swelling in the upper respiratory tract.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Steam inhalation, warm water. Apathya: Cold wind exposure, banana, curd.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 7 (Elaichi / Cold section)
safety_check: Safe across all adult groups including Hypertension and Diabetes

condition_name: Flatulence, Belching & Gaseous Distension (Adhmana & Udavarta)
remedy_name: Lahsun Swarasa with Madhu (Fresh Garlic Juice & Honey)
remedy_text: Take 6 ml fresh expressed juice of Lahsun (Allium sativum / Garlic) mixed with 1 teaspoon of raw honey twice a day after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Rasona (Garlic) is Snigdha, Ushna, Tikshna, and breaks stubborn Vata-Kapha gas locks (Avarana) in the gastrointestinal tract.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light diet. Apathya: Heavy pulses (Rajma, Chana), cold beverages.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 15 (Lahsun)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer and Infants under 1 year (Honey)

condition_name: Mild Spasmodic Abdominal Pain & Pediatric/Adult Colic (Udara Shoola)
remedy_name: Saunf Churna with Takra (Fennel Powder in Fresh Buttermilk)
remedy_text: Mix 3-5 gm fine powder of Saunf (Foeniculum vulgare / Fennel seeds) in a glass (200 ml) of fresh churned buttermilk (Takra) and take 3-4 times daily.
ayurvedic_note: Unlike hot carminatives (Hing, Ajvain, Garlic) that aggravate Pitta/ulcers, Shatapushpa (Saunf) with buttermilk relieves abdominal cramps while soothing gastric mucosa.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light rice with buttermilk, warm water. Apathya: Spicy, fried, and fermented foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 24 (Saunf)
safety_check: 100% Safe in Hyperacidity, Peptic Ulcer, Pregnancy, and Children

condition_name: Loss of Appetite & Indigestion with Feverishness (Agnimandya & Aruchi)
remedy_name: Tulsi Swarasa (Fresh Holy Basil Leaf Juice)
remedy_text: Take 5-10 ml fresh juice of Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) leaves twice or thrice daily before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Tulasi kindles digestive Agni (Deepana), digests Ama, and clears Kapha coating from the tongue and stomach without irritating the gut.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm freshly cooked meals. Apathya: Overeating, cold water with food.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 25 (Tulsi)
safety_check: Safe across all adult groups

condition_name: Sluggish Digestion with Mild Gastritis (Pitta-Kapha Agnimandya)
remedy_name: Dhania-Sonth Kwath (Coriander & Pinch of Dry Ginger Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20 ml decoction from 5 gm coarse Dhania (coriander) powder with a single pinch (250 mg) of Sonth (dry ginger) powder; drink warm thrice a day before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Combining cooling Dhanyaka (5 gm) with a tiny pinch of Sunthi balances Pitta while gently awakening digestive enzymes (Pachaka Pitta).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Moong dal soup, old rice, buttermilk. Apathya: Heavy fried foods.
source: Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 6 (Dhania)
safety_check: Safe across general populations including mild Gastritis

condition_name: Acute Fever with Coryza, Bronchitis & Body Ache (Kaphavata Jwara & Kasa)
remedy_name: Nidigdhikadi Kwath (Kantakari, Giloy, Ginger & Pippali Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from equal parts of Nidigdhika/Kantakari (Solanum xanthocarpum), Shunthi (dry ginger), and Guduchi (Giloy); add a pinch of Pippali powder and take warm twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 1, p. 327), Chakradatta (Jwarachikitsa), and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 115, p. 44: 'Nidigdhikarnagarakamritanam kwathah pibeyam marichapragalbhah') for curing fever accompanied by cough, breathlessness, chest pain, and chronic rhinitis (Peenasa).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light gruel (Peya). Apathya: Cold drinks, curd, daytime sleep.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 115 (p. 44); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 1 (p. 327); Chakradatta Jwarachikitsa
safety_check: Safe across adult groups; avoid Pippali topping in active Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Bilious Fever with Vomiting, Thirst & Burning (Pittashleshma Jwara)
remedy_name: Amritashtaka Kwath (Classical Eight-Herb Pitta-Kapha Fever Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from equal parts of Amrita/Guduchi (Giloy), Nimba bark, Patola leaves, Katuki, Asana, Shunthi, Raktachandana, and Musta; add a pinch of Pippali powder when cooled and take twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 112-113, p. 43) and Chakradatta. Resolves Pitta-Kapha fevers complicated by nausea, vomiting, burning sensation, and anorexia.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Laja Peya, pomegranate, boiled cooled water. Apathya: Spicy, oily, sour foods.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 112-113 (p. 43); Chakradatta Jwarachikitsa
safety_check: Avoid Katuki-containing decoction in Pregnancy

condition_name: Acute Fever with Indigestion & Toxic Mucus (Ama Jwara & Visuchika)
remedy_name: Sanjivani Vati (Classical Ama-Digesting & Antipyretic Tablet)
remedy_text: Classical tablet prepared from Vidanga, Shunthi, Pippali, Haritaki, Vibhitaki, Amalaki, Vacha, Guduchi, Shuddha Bhallataka, and Shuddha Vatsanabha triturated in Gomutra (125 mg tablet). Under Vaidya supervision, take 1 tablet (125 mg) with fresh ginger juice and warm water twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Documented in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara, p. 88) and Sharngadhara Samhita. Rapidly digests severe Ama in Ajirna (indigestion), Visuchika (gastroenteritis), and Ama Jwara.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light gruel. Apathya: Cold, heavy, oily foods.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara (p. 88)
safety_check: Vaidya-supervised formulation; STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Pregnancy, Children, Peptic Ulcer, and Pitta/Burning conditions

condition_name: Persistent Dry or Allergic Cough & Pharyngitis (Vata-Kapha Kasa)
remedy_name: Lavangadi Vati (Classical Clove-Catechu Cough Lozenge)
remedy_text: Composed of equal parts of Lavanga (Clove), Maricha (Black pepper), Vibhitaki (Baheda fruit rind), and Khadira Sara (Black catechu), triturated in Babbula bark decoction into 250-500 mg pills. Keep 1 pill in the mouth and suck slowly 3-4 times daily.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Kasachikitsa, p. 87) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali. Vibhitaki and Khadira exert potent astringent and antitussive action on the pharyngeal mucosa, stopping paroxysmal coughing spasms.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Lukewarm water, voice rest. Apathya: Cold water, sour curds, fried food.
source: Chakradatta Kasachikitsa (p. 87); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kasarogadhikara
safety_check: Sugar-free lozenge — SAFE in Diabetes and Hypertension!

condition_name: Chronic Bronchial Asthma, Hiccough & Allergic Rhinitis (Shwasa & Hikka)
remedy_name: Bharngi Guda / Bharngyadi Kwath (Clerodendrum serratum Asthma Formula)
remedy_text: 1) Decoction (Sugar-Free): Prepare 20 ml warm decoction from equal parts of Bharangi (Clerodendrum serratum), Pushkaramoola (Inula racemosa), Shati (Hedychium spicatum / Kapur Kachri — native to Uttarakhand), Shunthi, and Kantakari; take twice daily. 2) Classical Avaleha: Bharngi Guda (5 gm twice daily with warm water).
ayurvedic_note: In Chakradatta (Hikka-Shwasadhikara, p. 90-91), Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 20-21), and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 6), Bharangi, Pushkaramoola, and Shati are the premier antispasmodic bronchodilators for Shwasa (asthma) and pleuritic chest pain (Parshvashoola).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, horse gram soup, old rice. Apathya: Cold wind, dust, smoke, curd, fish.
source: Chakradatta Hikka-Shwasadhikara (p. 90-91); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 20-21); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 6
safety_check: Use sugar-free Bharngyadi Kwath in Diabetes; avoid in Pregnancy

condition_name: Productive Cough, Hoarseness & Sinus Catarrh (Kaphavata Kasa & Shiroroga)
remedy_name: Katphala (Uttarakhand Kafal Bark) Churna with Honey & Nasya
remedy_text: Take 1-2 gm fine powder of Katphala (Myrica esculenta / Kafal stem bark — indigenous to Garhwal & Kumaon hills) mixed with 1 tsp honey twice or thrice daily; OR gargle with warm Katphala bark decoction for sore throat and hoarseness.
ayurvedic_note: Highlighted in Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 20) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 116 Katphaladi Kwath, p. 45). Katphala (Kafal) is Kashaya-Tikta-Katu, Ushna Virya, and specifically clears Kapha-Vata from the throat, bronchi, and paranasal sinuses.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light hill grains. Apathya: Cold water, curd.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 20); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 116 (p. 45)
safety_check: Avoid honey in Infants under 1 year

condition_name: Dry Cough, Sore Throat, Hoarseness & Gastric Ulcer (Vata-Pitta Swarabheda & Kasa)
remedy_name: Yashtimadhu (Mulethi / Licorice) Churna with Ghee & Honey or Milk
remedy_text: Take 2-3 gm Yashtimadhu (Glycyrrhiza glabra / Mulethi) root powder mixed with 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp Honey (or in warm milk) twice daily; or slowly chew a small piece of clean Mulethi root for throat pain and voice strain.
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 8), Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 26), and Chakradatta (Swarabheda Chikitsa, p. 91), Madhuyashthi is Madhura Rasa, Sheeta Virya, Kanthya (voice-enhancing), Chakshushya, and Vrana-ropana (heals esophageal and gastric ulcers).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm milk, ghee, voice rest. Apathya: Spicy, sour, dry foods.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 8); Chakradatta Swarabheda Chikitsa (p. 91)
safety_check: CONTRAINDICATED IN HYPERTENSION (Glycyrrhizin in Mulethi causes sodium/water retention and elevates BP) and Infants <1 year (Honey)

condition_name: Chronic Sinusitis, Nasal Polyps, Allergic Rhinitis & Cervical Stiffness (Peenasa & Shiroroga)
remedy_name: Shadbindu Taila / Anu Taila Pratimarsha Nasya (Medicated Nasal Drops)
remedy_text: Warm the bottle slightly in hot water, lie down with head tilted back, and instill 2 drops of Anu Taila (daily preventive/mild) or Shadbindu Taila (prepared from Eranda moola, Tagara, Shatapushpa, Jeevanti, Rasna, Saindhava, Bhringaraja, Vidanga, Yashtimadhu, Shunthi in sesame oil and goat's milk) into each nostril every morning after face wash/steam.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 29 Nasya Vidhi, p. 166-169) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shirorogadhikara). Drains impacted Kapha from the sinuses, strengthens cranial nerves and eyesight, and prevents hair fall and premature greying.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water gargle after Nasya, avoiding cold wind for 30 minutes. Apathya: Instilling nasal drops immediately after food or bath.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 29 (p. 166-169); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Shirorogadhikara
safety_check: Do not administer strong Virechana Nasya during Pregnancy or in infants; 2 drops of plain warm cow's Ghee is safe for all

condition_name: Acute Indigestion by Subtype — Ama, Vidagdha & Vishtabdha Ajirna
remedy_name: Vacha-Saindhava Warm Water (Ama), Dhania-Misri Cold Water (Vidagdha) & Hing-Ajvain (Vishtabdha)
remedy_text: Differential Classical Protocol: 1) In Ama Ajirna (Kapha — heavy stomach, nausea, sweet/salty belching, coated tongue): Drink warm water with a pinch of Sonth and Saindhava, and fast (Langhana). 2) In Vidagdha Ajirna (Pitta — sour/burning belching, thirst, dizziness): Drink cool water with Dhania and Misri or take Abhaya (Haritaki) with Draksha (raisins). 3) In Vishtabdha Ajirna (Vata — severe bloating, colicky pain, trapped gas): Apply warm abdominal fomentation (Swedana) and take Hingvashtaka or Ajvain with warm saline water.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Agnimandyadhikara, p. 62) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Agnimandyadhikara, p. 227-228). Treating all indigestion with hot spices worsens Vidagdha (Pitta) indigestion; matching the exact subtype of Ajirna is the hallmark of an expert Vaidya.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Sleeping on the left side (Vamaparshwa shayana) aids digestion; resting until food digests. Apathya: Eating over undigested food (Adhyashana).
source: Chakradatta Agnimandyadhikara (p. 62); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadhikara (p. 227-228)
safety_check: Follow subtype-specific selection based on patient's belching and pain character

condition_name: Severe Gastric & Abdominal Colic with Acidity or Gas (Pittanila Shoola)
remedy_name: Shatavaryadi Jala / Triphala-Dhatri Churna with Honey & Ghee
remedy_text: For abdominal pain with burning (Pittaja/Pittavata Shoola): Take 3-5 gm Dhatri (Amla) Churna or Triphala Churna mixed with 1/2 tsp Ghee and 1 tsp Honey (or sugar/misri), followed by cool decoction of Shatavari, Yashtimadhu, Ushira, and Dhanyaka.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Shooladhikara, p. 139: 'Dhatrichurnam madhuyutam... pittashoolanibarhanam'). Unlike pungent Hing/Chitraka formulas that burn an inflamed stomach, Amalaki with Ghee and Shatavari relieves Pittaja colic and ulcer pain rapidly.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cold milk, coconut water, old rice, ghee. Apathya: Chili, sour, fried foods, alcohol.
source: Chakradatta Shooladhikara (p. 139)
safety_check: 100% Safe in Peptic Ulcer and Hypertension; avoid honey in infants <1 year

condition_name: Kaphaja & Ama Abdominal Pain, Heaviness & Sluggish Digestion (Kapha-Ama Shoola)
remedy_name: Panchakola Churna / Panchakola Yavagu (Five-Spice Digestive Formula)
remedy_text: Composed of equal parts of Pippali (Piper longum fruit), Pippalimoola (long pepper root), Chavya (Piper retrofractum), Chitraka (Plumbago zeylanica), and Nagara/Sunthi (dry ginger). Take 1-2 gm powder with warm water or cooked into thin rice gruel (Panchakola Yavagu) twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 14, p. 102) and Chakradatta (Shooladhikara, p. 139-140). Panchakola is the supreme classical group for cutting through sticky Kapha and Ama in the stomach, relieving dull heavy epigastric pain, anorexia, and ascites/splenomegaly.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light gruel, buttermilk. Apathya: Cold, sweet, dairy-heavy foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 14 (p. 102); Chakradatta Shooladhikara (p. 139-140)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Pregnancy and Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Chronic Malabsorption, Anorexia & Diarrhoea (Kapha-Vata Grahani)
remedy_name: Kapitthashtaka Churna (Classical Wood-Apple Eight-Ingredient Formula)
remedy_text: Prepared from unripe Kapittha (Limonia acidissima / Wood-apple pulp - 8 parts), Sugar (8 parts), Dadima (pomegranate), Tintidika, Pippali, Shunthi, Maricha, Musta, Bilva, Dhataki, Yavani, Dhanyaka, Jeeraka (1 part each), and Trijata. Take 3-5 gm with buttermilk twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 11, p. 394) and Chakradatta (Grahanychikitsa, p. 39-40) for curing chronic Grahani, loose stools, loss of taste (Aruchi), cough, and throat disorders.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, old rice, pomegranate. Apathya: Milk, heavy pulses, leafy greens.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 11 (p. 394); Chakradatta Grahanychikitsa (p. 39-40)
safety_check: Omit sugar in uncontrolled Diabetes

condition_name: Chronic Piles, Constipation & Anal Fissure (Arsha, Vibandha & Parikartika)
remedy_name: Abhayarishta & Surana (Jimikand / Elephant Foot Yam) Pathya Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Classical Arishta: Take 15-20 ml Abhayarishta (prepared from Haritaki, Draksha, Vidanga, Madhuka pushpa, Gokshura, Trivrit, Dhanyaka, Danti, Indravaruni, Chavya, Saunf, Shunthi, Mocharasa) mixed with equal water twice daily after meals. 2) Dietary Specific: Eat steamed/cooked Surana (Amorphophallus campanulatus / Jimikand) seasoned with a little Ghee and buttermilk daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Chakradatta (Arshachikitsa, p. 46-48: Svalpa/Brihat Shurana Modaka) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 7, p. 56: 'Suranah dipanah shreshthah kapharshoghnashcha'), Surana (Jimikand) and Abhayarishta are the foremost specific remedies for shrinking hemorrhoids and keeping stools soft.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Jimikand (Surana), buttermilk, papaya, warm sitz bath. Apathya: Chili, potato, maida, prolonged sitting.
source: Chakradatta Arshachikitsa (p. 46-48); Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 7 (p. 56) & Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 383)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (contains Haritaki/Trivrit/Danti); cooked Jimikand with buttermilk is safe

condition_name: Non-Bleeding Internal Piles & Abdominal Masses (Shushka Arsha & Gulma)
remedy_name: Kankayana Gutika (Classical Yavakshara-Hingu-Surana Tablet)
remedy_text: Classical pill prepared from Shati, Pushkaramoola, Danti, Chitraka, Adhaki, Shunthi, Vacha, Trivrit, Hingu, Yavakshara, Amlavetasa, Yamani, Jeeraka, Maricha, Dhanyaka, Upakunchika, Ajmoda, and Surana powder triturated with lemon juice. Take 1-2 tablets (250-500 mg) with buttermilk twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Arshachikitsa, p. 47) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 16, p. 414). Resolves Vata-Kapha pile masses and abdominal bloating.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, light warm diet. Apathya: Heavy, dry, constipating foods.
source: Chakradatta Arshachikitsa (p. 47); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 (p. 414)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy, Bleeding Piles (Raktarsha), and Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Mild Pediatric, Geriatric & Pregnancy-Safe Constipation (Mridu Koshtha Vibandha)
remedy_name: Aragwadha Phala Majja (Amaltas Pulp) with Warm Milk or Munakka (Draksha)
remedy_text: Boil 5-10 gm sweet pulp of Aragwadha (Cassia fistula / Amaltas pod) OR 8-10 deseeded black raisins (Draksha / Munakka) in 150 ml milk, mash well, and drink lukewarm at bedtime.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Chaturangulah mriduvirechananam' & Kalpasthana Ch. 2, p. 466) and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 12), Aragwadha (Amaltas) and Draksha are the safest, non-griping mild laxatives (Sukha-virechana) specifically indicated for children, pregnant women, the elderly, and patients with fever or heart disease.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, soaked raisins, cow's milk with ghee. Apathya: Dry, astringent foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98) & Kalpasthana Ch. 2 (p. 466); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 12)
safety_check: 100% Safe in Pregnancy, Pediatrics, Hypertension, and Gastritis; omit Munakka if uncontrolled Diabetes

condition_name: Tapeworm, Roundworm, Pinworm & Chronic Helminthiasis (Krimi Roga)
remedy_name: Vidangadi Churna / Palasha Beeja & Kampillaka Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Vidangadi Churna: Take 2-3 gm powder of Vidanga (Embelia ribes / Vaividang), Saindhava, Yavakshara, Kampillaka (Mallotus philippensis), and Haritaki with buttermilk in the morning. 2) Palasha Beeja Yoga: Take 1-2 gm powder of Palasha (Butea monosperma) seeds with buttermilk or honey for 3 days.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 97: 'Vidangam krimighnanam'), Chakradatta (Krimirogadhikara, p. 64), and Madanapala Nighantu (p. 11), Vidanga, Palasha beeja, and Kampillaka are the most potent classical anthelmintics.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Buttermilk, garlic, bitter gourd, washing hands and trimming nails. Apathya: Milk, curd, jaggery, leafy greens, raw unwashed salads.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 97); Chakradatta Krimirogadhikara (p. 64); Madanapala Nighantu (p. 11)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (Vidanga possesses anti-fertility/embryotoxic activity)

condition_name: Head Lice & Scalp Parasites (Yuka & Liksha / Keshaja Krimi)
remedy_name: Vidangadi Taila / Neem Seed & Sitaphala (Custard Apple) Seed External Scalp Paste
remedy_text: Apply Mustard/Coconut oil boiled with Vidanga, Neem seeds/leaves, and Dhattura/Rasanjana (OR a paste of crushed Neem seeds and Sitaphala seeds) over the scalp and hair for 1 hour before washing thoroughly. Keep strictly away from eyes and mouth.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Krimirogadhikara — Yuka Chikitsa, p. 65) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 22, p. 446). Eradicates adult lice (Yuka) and nits (Liksha).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Fine-tooth combing, boiling bed linen and combs. Apathya: Sharing towels/combs.
source: Chakradatta Krimirogadhikara (p. 65); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 22 (p. 446)
safety_check: EXTERNAL SCALP APPLICATION ONLY — Never ingest; keep strictly away from eyes

condition_name: Anemia with Hyperacidity, Weakness & Pregnancy/Postpartum Pallor (Pittaja Pandu)
remedy_name: Dhatri Lauha (Classical Amalaki-Iron Hematinic Formula)
remedy_text: Composed of Dhatri (Amalaki Churna - 4 parts), Lauha Bhasma (2 parts), and Yashtimadhu Churna (1 part), impregnated (Bhavana) for 7 days in Guduchi (Giloy) decoction. Take 250-500 mg twice daily with 1/2 tsp Ghee and 1 tsp Honey after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Pandurogadhikara, p. 152 & Shoolarogadhikara) and Chakradatta. Because Lauha is chelated with Vitamin-C-rich Amalaki, cooling Yashtimadhu, and Guduchi, it raises hemoglobin rapidly without causing gastric irritation or constipation (unlike synthetic ferrous sulfate).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Pomegranate, Amla, milk, ghee, old rice, green leafy vegetables. Apathya: Tea/coffee immediately after meals (blocks iron absorption), sour pickles.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Pandurogadhikara (p. 152); Chakradatta Pandurogadhikara (p. 66)
safety_check: Avoid in hemochromatosis/iron overload; omit Yashtimadhu component if severe Hypertension

condition_name: Acute & Subacute Hepatitis, Jaundice & Sluggish Liver (Kamala & Halimaka)
remedy_name: Kakamachi (Makoi) & Bhringaraja Swarasa with Bhumyamalaki
remedy_text: Take 10 ml fresh expressed juice (or 20 ml decoction) of whole plant of Bhumyamalaki (Phyllanthus niruri / Bhui Amla), Kakamachi (Solanum nigrum / Makoi), and Bhringaraja (Eclipta alba) twice daily on an empty stomach with 1 tsp buttermilk or Mishri.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 24-25: Bhringaraja & Kakamachi) and Chakradatta (Pandurogadhikara, p. 66-67). Potent hepatoprotective and antiviral combination that clears bilirubin (Pitta-rechaka) and regenerates hepatocytes.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Sugarcane juice, radish, buttermilk, barley, boiled water. Apathya: Alcohol, oil/ghee, non-veg, spicy food.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 24-25); Chakradatta Pandurogadhikara (p. 66-67)
safety_check: Yellow-tier condition: always pair with PHC Liver Function Test (LFT) monitoring

condition_name: Jaundice, Fatty Liver & Hepatic Congestion (Kamala & Yakrit Vriddhi)
remedy_name: Daruharidra (Uttarakhand Kilmora / Berberis aristata) Kwath with Honey
remedy_text: Prepare 20 ml decoction from 3-5 gm stem/root bark of Daruharidra (Berberis aristata / Kilmora or Kingora — abundant across Chamoli & Uttarakhand hills) and Amalaki; cool and take with 1 tsp honey every morning.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 18, p. 428: 'Darvya nimbasya va rasam pratah pratar madhuyutam kamalartaya yojayet') and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 23), Daruharidra (Kilmora) is rich in berberine, clearing hepatic bile stasis, jaundice, and metabolic syndrome.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Boiled water, light low-fat diet. Apathya: Alcohol, fried food.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 18 (p. 428); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 23)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY and Infants <1 year (Berberine displaces bilirubin in neonates and stimulates uterus)

condition_name: Type-2 Diabetes with Polyuria, Burning Hands/Feet & Debility (Madhumeha & Prameha)
remedy_name: Jambu Beeja-Gudmar-Vijaysar Churna & Shuddha Shilajatu
remedy_text: 1) Herbal Churna: Take 3-5 gm powder of Jambu Beeja (Syzygium cumini / Jamun seed), Amalaki, and Haridra with water twice daily before meals; OR drink 50 ml water soaked overnight in a Vijaysar (Pterocarpus marsupium / Asana) heartwood tumbler. 2) Classical Rasayana: Take 250-500 mg Shuddha Shilajatu with Triphala/Salasaradi decoction once daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 14 Prameha Chikitsa, p. 405-407 & Uttarasthana Ch. 49, p. 719) and Ayurvedaprakasha (Ch. 7 Shilajatu, p. 104), Asana (Vijaysar), Jambu, and Shilajatu check excessive urination (Prabhuta-avila mutrata) and reverse diabetic tissue depletion (Dhatukshaya).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Barley (Yava), old wheat, bitter gourd, Jamun fruit, regular physical exercise. Apathya: Sugar, jaggery, rice, potato, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 14 (p. 405-407); Ayurvedaprakasha Ch. 7 (p. 104)
safety_check: Avoid Shilajatu in Pregnancy and acute febrile states; monitor blood sugar

condition_name: Renal Calculi (Kidney Stones) & Crystalluria (Mutrashmari & Sharkara)
remedy_name: Varunadi Kwath & Pashanabheda-Kulattha (Pakhanbhed & Gahat) Decoction
remedy_text: Boil equal parts (5 gm total) of Varuna bark (Crataeva nurvala), Pashanabheda rhizome (Bergenia ligulata / Silphori — native to Uttarakhand rocks), Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris), and Shunthi in 200 ml water until reduced to 50 ml; add a pinch of Yavakshara or old jaggery and drink twice daily. Eat Gahat (Kulattha / horse gram) soup daily.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 Mutraghata Chikitsa, p. 401-402), Chakradatta (Ashmarichikitsa), and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 21: Pashanabheda). Pashanabheda and Varuna inhibit calcium oxalate crystallization and disintegrate stones (Ashmari-bhedana).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: 3+ liters water daily, Gahat dal soup, barley water, tender coconut water. Apathya: Spinach, tomato, excess calcium/oxalate foods, suppressing urination.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 13 (p. 401-402); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 21)
safety_check: Avoid Yavakshara in Pregnancy; seek urgent PHC ultrasound if severe flank pain with fever/vomiting occurs

condition_name: Chronic UTI, Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH) & Dysuria (Mutraghata & Mutrakricchra)
remedy_name: Gokshuradi Guggulu & Chandraprabha Vati
remedy_text: Take 1-2 tablets (250-500 mg) of Gokshuradi Guggulu (prepared from Gokshura, Guggulu, Trikatu, Triphala, Musta) or Chandraprabha Vati twice daily after meals with Musta/Pashanabheda decoction or warm water.
ayurvedic_note: From Sharngadhara Samhita and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Mutrakricchradhikara). Tones the detrusor muscle, reduces prostatic/bladder-neck congestion (Vatashthila), and clears urinary tract inflammation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Barley water, Punarnava, old rice, warm sitz bath. Apathya: Alcohol, riding/prolonged sitting, holding urine.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Mutrakricchradhikara & Pramehadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (contains Guggulu)

condition_name: Goiter, Hypothyroidism, Cervical Lymphadenitis, Fibroids & PCOS (Galaganda, Gandamala & Granthi)
remedy_name: Kanchanara Bark Kwath (Bauhinia variegata) & Kanchanara Guggulu
remedy_text: 1) Decoction: Boil 5-10 gm coarse powder of Kanchanara (Bauhinia variegata / Kachnar) stem bark with a pinch of Shunthi (dry ginger) in 160 ml water until reduced to 40 ml; drink twice daily on an empty stomach. 2) Classical Tablet: Kanchanara Guggulu (1-2 tablets twice daily with warm water).
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 16: 'Kovidaro himo grahi... gandamalagudabhranshakushthapradaranashanah'), Chakradatta (Galagandadhikara), and Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Kanchanara is the specific Kapha-Meda scraping (Lekhana) herb for thyroid enlargement (Galaganda), lymphadenitis (Gandamala), lipomas, and ovarian cysts/fibroids (Granthi).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Barley, old rice, drumstick (Shigru), iodized/rock salt, exercise. Apathya: Heavy dairy, sweets, raw cabbage/cauliflower in goiter, daytime sleep.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 16); Chakradatta Galaganda-Gandamaladhikara; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Galagandadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (Guggulu)

condition_name: Rheumatoid Arthritis, Joint Stiffness & Constipation (Amavata)
remedy_name: Vaishwanara Churna (Classical Five-Ingredient Ama-Digesting Powder)
remedy_text: Composed of Saindhava Lavana (2 parts), Yavani/Ajvain (2 parts), Ajmoda (3 parts), Nagara/Sunthi (5 parts), and Haritaki Churna (12 parts). Take 3-5 gm with lukewarm water or buttermilk after meals or at bedtime.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Amavatadhikara, p. 132) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Amavatadhikara) for kindling Jatharagni (Vaishwanara), digesting joint-lodged Ama, and inducing gentle Vata-anulomana (bowel clearance) in rheumatoid arthritis, backache, and flatulence.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, barley, horse gram, bitter gourd, dry sand fomentation (Valuka Sweda). Apathya: Curd, cold water, heavy sweets, daytime sleep.
source: Chakradatta Amavatadhikara (p. 132); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Amavatadhikara
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (contains Haritaki), Peptic Ulcer, and uncontrolled Hypertension (contains Saindhava)

condition_name: Chronic Rheumatoid Arthritis, Gout & Sciatica (Amavata & Vatarakta)
remedy_name: Simhanada Guggulu & Ajamodadi Vataka
remedy_text: 1) Simhanada Guggulu: Prepared by cooking Triphala decoction with purified Gandhaka (1 part), Guggulu (1 part), and Eranda Taila (castor oil - 4 parts) in an iron vessel; take 1-2 tablets (500 mg) twice daily with warm water. 2) Ajamodadi Churna/Vataka (Ajmoda, Vidanga, Saindhava, Devadaru, Chitraka, Pippali moola, Shatapushpa, Pippali, Maricha, Haritaki, Vriddhadaru, Shunthi): 2-3 gm with warm water.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Amavatadhikara, p. 133-134: 'Simhanadeti vikhyato roganamajayajjaye') and Bhaishajya Ratnavali. Clears chronic Ama from synovial joints and relieves crippled mobility (Khanja/Pangu).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light diet, dry heat fomentation. Apathya: Cold, oily, heavy dairy foods.
source: Chakradatta Amavatadhikara (p. 133-134); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Amavatadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY, Diarrhea, and Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Degenerative Osteoarthritis, Spondylosis & Neuromuscular Pain (Sandhivata & Vatavyadhi)
remedy_name: Yogaraja Guggulu & Mahayogaraja Guggulu with Rasnadi Kwath
remedy_text: Take 1-2 tablets (250-500 mg) of Yogaraja Guggulu (prepared from Chitraka, Pippalimoola, Yavani, Karavi, Vidanga, Ajmoda, Jeeraka, Suradaru, Chavya, Ela, Saindhava, Kushtha, Rasna, Gokshura, Dhanyaka, Triphala, Musta, Trikatu, Tvak, Ushira, Yavakshara, Talisa, Patra, Ghee, and Guggulu) twice daily after meals with warm water or Rasnadi Kwath.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Amavatadhikara, p. 133) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Vatavyadhyadhikara). Nourishes and clears Vata from joints, bones, and marrow (Asthi-Majjagata Vata).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm sesame oil massage (Abhyanga), warm water, wheat, garlic, milk with ghee. Apathya: Cold water, dry/stale foods, night vigil.
source: Chakradatta Amavatadhikara (p. 133); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Vatavyadhyadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (contains Guggulu)

condition_name: Frozen Shoulder, Brachial Plexus Pain & Stiff Neck (Avabahuka, Vishwachi & Manyastambha)
remedy_name: Prasarini Taila Abhyanga & Masha-Bala Kwath
remedy_text: 1) External Massage & Nasya: Massage the affected shoulder, neck, and arm with warm Prasarini Taila (prepared from Paederia foetida / Gandhaprasarini, til oil, curd, kanji, milk, and Vatahara herbs) or Mahanarayana Taila twice daily followed by steam fomentation. 2) Oral: Drink 20 ml warm decoction of Bala root, Masha (black gram), Rasna, Devadaru, and Shunthi.
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 18: Prasarini), Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa), and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 23), Prasarini ('stretching/restoring movement') and Bala specifically release contracted shoulder tendons (Sira-snayu sankocha) in frozen shoulder.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Gentle pendulum shoulder exercises after warm oil massage, sleeping on a low comfortable pillow. Apathya: Sleeping on the affected arm, cold drafts.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 18); Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa; Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 23
safety_check: Safe across all adult groups

condition_name: Plantar Fasciitis, Heel Pain & Ankle Sprain (Vatakantaka & Padashoola)
remedy_name: Eranda Patra (Castor Leaf) Warm Poultice & Brick/Salt Dry Fomentation (ishtika Sweda)
remedy_text: 1) Local Fomentation & Wrap: Coat a fresh Eranda (Ricinus communis / Castor) leaf or Calotropis (Arka/Aak) leaf with warm sesame/castor oil and a pinch of Saindhava (rock salt) and Haldi, warm it over a pan, and tie it over the painful heel overnight; OR perform warm salt-water foot soak followed by Mahanarayana oil massage. 2) Oral: Take 5 ml Eranda Taila with 20 ml Dashamoola/Rasna Kwath.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 23 Vatavyadhi Chikitsa, p. 450) and Chakradatta. Vatakantaka occurs when walking on uneven/rocky hill terrain (common in Uttarakhand) aggravates local Vata in the calcaneal tendon (Khudaka/Gulpha Sandhi).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cushioned footwear, warm foot soak every evening. Apathya: Walking barefoot on cold stone floors.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 23 (p. 450); Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa
safety_check: Topical leaf wrap & foot soak are 100% safe for all; avoid oral Eranda Taila in Pregnancy

condition_name: Burning Soles/Palms, Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy & Heat Sensation (Padadaha & Daha)
remedy_name: Shatadhauta Ghrita / Navanita-Ushira Foot Massage & Chandanadi/Sarivadi Hima
remedy_text: 1) Topical Foot Massage (Padabhyanga): Massage the soles of the feet before sleep with Shatadhauta Ghrita (cow's Ghee washed 100 times with cold water/Amla decoction in a copper/bronze vessel) or fresh butter mixed with Ushira (Khus) and Chandana powder. 2) Oral: Drink 20 ml cold infusion of Sariva (Anantamoola), Ushira, and Amalaki.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa & Dahadhikara, p. 100-101) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 23). Pacifies Pitta-Vata irritation in peripheral nerves and improves sleep and vision.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cool foot wash, Amla, pomegranate, milk. Apathya: Spicy/hot foods, walking barefoot in hot sun.
source: Chakradatta Dahadhikara (p. 100-101); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 23
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients including Diabetes, Pregnancy, and Hypertension

condition_name: Acute Joint Effusion, Synovitis & Swollen Painful Knee (Kroshtukashirsha & Sandhishotha)
remedy_name: Guduchi-Triphala-Guggulu & Shigru-Punarnava-Haridra Warm Lepa
remedy_text: 1) External Anti-Edema Lepa: Apply a warm paste of Shigru (Moringa oleifera / Drumstick tree) bark/leaves, Punarnava root, Shunthi, and Haridra over the swollen knee joint. 2) Oral: Drink 20-30 ml decoction of Guduchi (Giloy) and Triphala twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa) and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 16-17 & 31: Shigru), Kroshtukashirsha (swollen knee resembling a jackal's head) is treated by resolving synovial fluid accumulation (Kleda/Rakta-Vata) with Guduchi and Shigru.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Rest to the knee, elevation, warm water, drumstick soup. Apathya: Squatting, climbing steep stairs during acute effusion, curd.
source: Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa; Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 17, 31)
safety_check: Guduchi-Triphala decoction (without Haritaki/Guggulu) and Shigru external paste are safe; avoid Guggulu in Pregnancy

condition_name: Ringworm, Tinea &Stubborn Fungal Skin Patches (Dadru Kushtha)
remedy_name: Chakramarda (Panwar / Cassia tora) Seed Lepa with Kanji/Nimbu & Gandhaka Rasayana
remedy_text: 1) Specific Topical Antifungal Paste: Grind seeds of Chakramarda / Prapunnada (Cassia tora / Panwar — grows wild across Uttarakhand foothills) with sour buttermilk, lemon juice, or radish juice into a fine paste along with a pinch of Haridra; apply over ringworm patches twice daily. 2) Classical Oral (Vaidya supervision): Gandhaka Rasayana (250-500 mg twice daily with milk).
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 23: 'Prapunnado laghuh swaduh... dadrukushthakrimipranut'), Chakradatta (Kushthachikitsa), and Ayurvedaprakasha (Ch. 2 Gandhaka, p. 47), Chakramarda ('destroyer of circular ringworm patches') and purified Gandhaka are the definitive classical cures for Dadru (tinea/ringworm).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Loose cotton clothes, keeping skin folds dry, bitter vegetables. Apathya: Curd, jaggery, sweets, sharing towels, synthetic tight clothing.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 23); Chakradatta Kushthachikitsa; Ayurvedaprakasha Ch. 2 (p. 47)
safety_check: Topical Chakramarda paste is 100% safe for all

condition_name: Leucoderma / Vitiligo & Hypopigmented Skin Patches (Shwitra / Kilasa)
remedy_name: Bakuchi (Psoralea corylifolia) Churna & Avalgujadi Lepa
remedy_text: 1) Oral (Under Vaidya Supervision): Take 1-2 gm Shuddha Bakuchi (Psoralea corylifolia / Somaraji) seed powder with Amalaki and Khadira decoction after meals. 2) External (Under Vaidya Supervision): Apply diluted Bakuchi oil mixed with coconut oil on white patches and expose to mild early-morning (7-8 AM) sunlight for 5-10 minutes (discontinue if blistering/redness occurs).
ayurvedic_note: Documented in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 22 Shwitra Chikitsa, p. 444-445) and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 23: Bakuchi). Stimulates melanocytes (Bhrajaka Pitta) to restore skin pigment.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Old rice, Moong dal, bitter gourd, Khadira water. Apathya: Strictly avoid incompatible foods (Milk + Fish, Milk + Sour fruits/Salt), curd, urad dal.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 22 (p. 444-445); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 23)
safety_check: Vaidya-supervised therapy: diluted topical application only (concentrated Bakuchi causes phototoxic blistering); contraindicated in Pregnancy and Children

condition_name: Hyper-Pigmentation, Chronic Eczema, Acne Scars & Blood Impurity (Vyanga, Visarpa & Raktadosha)
remedy_name: Manjishthadi Kwath (Rubia cordifolia Blood-Purifying Decoction) & Manjishtha-Madhu Lepa
remedy_text: 1) Oral Blood Purifier: Boil 5 gm coarse powder of Manjishtha (Rubia cordifolia), Triphala, Guduchi, Nimba bark, Haridra, Daruharidra, Bakuchi, Patola, and Katuki in 160 ml water down to 40 ml; drink twice daily. 2) External Face Pack: Apply fine Manjishtha root powder mixed with honey or raw milk over dark spots, acne scars, and melasma (Vyanga).
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 22: 'Manjishtha madhura tikta... swarya varnya vishashophayoninetrarujapaha') and Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 37, p. 640), Manjishtha is the premier Varnya (complexion-enhancing) and Raktaprasadana (blood-purifying) herb.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Pomegranate, Amla, green gram, adequate water. Apathya: Spicy, sour, fermented foods, excess sun exposure.
source: Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 22); Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 37 (p. 640); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kushthadhikara
safety_check: Topical paste is safe for all; avoid internal Manjishthadi Kwath during Pregnancy

condition_name: Non-Healing Ulcers, Diabetic Foot Sores, Fistula & Fissures (Dushtavrana, Nadivrana & Parikartika)
remedy_name: Jatyadi Taila / Jatyadi Ghrita (Classical Jasmine-Neem Wound-Healing Oil)
remedy_text: Clean the wound with warm Triphala or Neem decoction, then apply sterile gauze soaked in Jatyadi Taila or Jatyadi Ghrita (prepared from Jati/Jasmine leaves, Nimba leaves, Patola, Karanja, Siktha/beeswax, Madhuka, Kushtha, Haridra, Daruharidra, Katuki, Manjishtha, Padmaka, Lodhra, Abhaya, Nilotpala, Tuttha, and Sariva) twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 30 Vrana Pratishedha, p. 619: 'Jatyadi ghritam tailam va... dushtavranashodhanaropanam') and Chakradatta (Vranashothachikitsa). Simultaneously debrides slough (Vrana-shodhana) and accelerates epithelialization (Vrana-ropana) in chronic ulcers and anal fissures.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Keeping wound clean and dry, old rice, Moong dal, protein/Vitamin-C rich diet. Apathya: Curd, sour/fermented foods, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 30 (p. 619); Chakradatta Vranashothachikitsa
safety_check: External wound dressing — safe for all; diabetic foot ulcers require concurrent PHC glycemic and vascular care

condition_name: Herpes Zoster (Shingles), Erysipelas & Acute Burning Blisters (Visarpa & Kaksha)
remedy_name: Dashanga Lepa / Shatadhauta Ghrita Topical Application & Patoladi-Amalaki Kwath
remedy_text: 1) Topical Cooling Lepa: Apply Dashanga Lepa (Shirish bark, Yashtimadhu, Tagara, Raktachandana, Ela, Jatamansi, Haridra, Daruharidra, Kushtha, Hrivera) mixed with cold water and 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee, OR pure Shatadhauta Ghrita gently over the burning vesicles. 2) Oral: Drink 20-30 ml cooled decoction of Patola, Triphala, Guduchi, Nimba, and Musta twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 20 Visarpa Chikitsa, p. 431-432) and Chakradatta, Visarpa (acute spreading vesicular/erysipeloid skin inflammation) is dominated by Pitta and Rakta; cooling Ghrita-Lepas and Tikta-Kashaya decoctions extinguish burning pain and prevent post-herpetic neuralgia.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cool milk, pomegranate, barley, old rice, rest. Apathya: Hot sun, spicy/sour/salty foods, scratching blisters.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 20 (p. 431-432); Chakradatta Visarpachikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Visarpadhikara
safety_check: Note: Herpes zoster near the eye (ophthalmic shingles) is an urgent Yellow/Red referral to PHC ophthalmologist!

condition_name: Boils, Abscesses, Folliculitis & Perianal Abscess Prevention (Vidradhi, Pidika & Bhagandara)
remedy_name: Triphala Guggulu & Shigru-Haridra-Ghee Poultice (Upanaha)
remedy_text: 1) Oral (Classical Natural Anti-Inflammatory): Take 1-2 tablets (500 mg) of Triphala Guggulu (prepared from Triphala, Pippali, and purified Guggulu) twice daily with warm water after meals. 2) Topical: In early unripe stage (Apakwa), apply cooling paste of Haridra, Manjishtha, and Ghee; if pus is forming, apply warm poultice of Shigru, barley flour, and sesame/linseed to promote drainage.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 15 Vidradhi-Vriddhi Chikitsa, p. 408 & Uttarasthana Ch. 33 Bhagandara Pratishedha, p. 628) and Chakradatta. Triphala Guggulu resolves deep tissue inflammation (Shotha), dries purulent discharge (Kleda-shoshana), and heals post-surgical/traumatic wounds.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Old rice, Moong dal, bitter gourd, drumstick, warm sitz bath (for perianal boils). Apathya: Curd, sweets, fried food, riding on hard surfaces.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 15 (p. 408) & Uttarasthana Ch. 33 (p. 628); Chakradatta Vranashothachikitsa
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (contains Guggulu and Haritaki)

condition_name: Cracked Heels, Palmar/Plantar Keratoderma & Dry Chapped Skin (Padadari & Vicharchika)
remedy_name: Sarjarasa-Siktha-Saindhava-Ghrita Lepa (Classical Cracked Heel Balm)
remedy_text: Soak feet in warm salt water for 10 minutes, scrub gently, pat dry, and apply a warm salve made by melting pure cow's Ghee (or sesame/coconut oil) with Siktha (natural beeswax / Mom), Sarjarasa (Ral / Vateria indica resin), a pinch of Saindhava (rock salt), and Haridra powder over the cracked heels before wearing cotton socks at bedtime.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 37 Kshudraroga Pratishedha, p. 639: 'Sarjarasasindhujanmamadhuchishtam... padadarim jayet') and Chakradatta (Kshudrarogachikitsa). Walking barefoot in cold mountain weather dries local Vata in the heels (Padadari); Snehana-Swedana followed by Siktha-Ghrita seals moisture and heals deep painful fissures.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Wearing footwear outdoors, warm foot bath at night. Apathya: Walking barefoot on cold/rough ground.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 37 (p. 639); Chakradatta Kshudrarogachikitsa
safety_check: 100% Safe external application for all patients

condition_name: Heavy Menstrual Bleeding, Menorrhagia & Metrorrhagia (Asrigdara / Raktapradara)
remedy_name: Ashoka Bark Ksheerapaka (Saraca asoca Milk Decoction) & Lodhra-Tandulodaka Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Ashoka Ksheerapaka: Boil 5-10 gm coarse powder of Ashoka (Saraca asoca) stem bark in 100 ml cow's milk and 400 ml water until reduced to 100 ml milk; strain, cool, add 1 tsp Misri (rock candy), and drink twice daily. 2) Lodhra Yoga: Take 3 gm fine powder of Lodhra (Symplocos racemosa) bark with 1 tsp honey followed by Tandulodaka (washed rice water) twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Chakradatta (Asrigdarachikitsa), Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Strirogadhikara), and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 20: Lodhra), Ashoka Ksheerapaka and Lodhra are Kashaya Rasa, Sheeta Virya, and potent uterine astringents (Garbhashaya-sankochaka and Raktastambhana).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, pomegranate, Amla, rice water (Tandulodaka), complete rest. Apathya: Spicy, sour, hot foods, sesame, jaggery, heavy lifting.
source: Chakradatta Asrigdarachikitsa; Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 20); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Strirogadhikara
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy and Amenorrhea; check hemoglobin/CBC at PHC if bleeding is prolonged

condition_name: Oligomenorrhea, Delayed/Scanty Menses & PCOS Support (Artavakshaya & Nashtartava)
remedy_name: Tila-Guda-Shunthi Kwath (Black Sesame & Jaggery Decoction) & Kumari Swarasa
remedy_text: Boil 5-10 gm black sesame seeds (Krishna Tila) and 1 gm dry ginger (Shunthi) in 160 ml water down to 40 ml, mix with 5 gm old Jaggery (Guda), and drink warm twice daily for 5-7 days prior to expected menses; OR take 10 ml fresh Aloe vera (Kumari) pulp with a pinch of black pepper and turmeric.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sharirasthana Ch. 1, p. 215: 'Tatra artavakshaye yathasvam doshashodhanam agneyanam cha dravyanam tilakulathamaishasuradinam upayogah') and Madanapala Nighantu, Krishna Tila with Guda and Kulattha (Gahat) are Artavajanana (emmenagogue), restoring normal ovulatory and menstrual flow.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Black sesame, horse gram (Gahat), garlic, papaya, regular yoga/walking. Apathya: Cold, heavy, bakery/refined foods, sedentary lifestyle.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sharirasthana Ch. 1 (p. 215); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Yonivyapadadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY (always rule out pregnancy before using emmenagogues!) and Diabetes (Guda)

condition_name: Pregnancy Morning Sickness, Nausea & Vomiting (Garbhini Chhardi)
remedy_name: Laja Churna (Parched Paddy Powder) with Elaichi, Dadima & Nimbu Sip
remedy_text: Mix 5-10 gm Laja Churna (powder of parched paddy / Kheel) with 250 mg Elaichi (cardamom) seed powder, 1 tsp fresh sweet Anar (pomegranate) juice or Nimbu juice, and 1 tsp sugar/misri in cool water or thin gruel (Laja Manda); sip in small quantities frequently.
ayurvedic_note: Specifically prescribed in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sharirasthana Ch. 3 Garbhopacharaniya, p. 233 & Chikitsasthana Ch. 8) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Garbhini-rogadhikara). Laja (parched rice) and Elaichi are 100% teratogen-free, Garbha-sthapaka (fetus-stabilizing), and immediately calm gastric irritation in pregnant women without using hot/uterotonic herbs.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Small frequent meals, parched rice (Kheel), pomegranate, coconut water, pleasant aromas. Apathya: Spicy, greasy, strong-smelling foods, fasting.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sharirasthana Ch. 3 (p. 233); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Garbhinirogadhikara; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 3, 7, 21
safety_check: 100% SAFE IN PREGNANCY; seek PHC care if hyperemesis (inability to keep any fluids down / ketonuria) occurs

condition_name: Postpartum Recovery, Uterine Involution & Backache (Sutika Paricharya & Sutika Vata)
remedy_name: Dashamoola Kwath & Panchakola-Guda / Saubhagya Shunthi Paka
remedy_text: For postpartum mothers (after childbirth): 1) Drink 20-30 ml warm Dashamoola Kwath (decoction of ten classical roots) twice daily. 2) Take 5 gm Methi-Sonth-Ajvain-Jaggery-Ghee Ladoo (Saubhagya Shunthi Paka) with warm milk every morning, and perform gentle warm sesame oil massage (Abhyanga) and abdominal binding (Udara-veshtana).
ayurvedic_note: Detailed in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sharirasthana Ch. 3 Sutika Upachara, p. 239-240) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Sutikarogadhikara). Immediately after delivery, the sudden emptiness of the uterus (Shunya-sharira) causes severe Vata aggravation; Dashamoola and Shunthi-Methi-Ghee restore Agni, promote lochial cleansing (Garbhashaya-shuddhi), prevent postpartum fever/backache, and boost lactation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm boiled water, moong soup, milk with ghee, rest in a draft-free warm room. Apathya: Cold water, raw salads, heavy lifting, emotional stress.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sharirasthana Ch. 3 (p. 239-240); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Sutikarogadhikara; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 18
safety_check: Specifically for POSTPARTUM (after delivery) care — do not use पंचकोल/गुड़ uterine-cleansing dose during pregnancy

condition_name: Pediatric Teething Troubles, Gum Irritation & Loose Stools (Dantodbheda Janya Vikara)
remedy_name: Pippali-Amalaki-Madhu Gum Rub (Pratisarana) & Musta-Ativisha Decoction
remedy_text: 1) Gentle Gum Massage: Mix a tiny pinch of fine Amalaki (Amla) or Dhataki flower powder with a drop of cow's Ghee (or honey if child is >1 year) and gently rub on the child's swollen gums twice daily. 2) For Teething Diarrhoea: Give 5-10 ml cooled decoction of Musta (Nagarmotha) and Bilva pulp (or a pinch of rubbed Jayphal in mother's milk) twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 2 Balamaya Pratishedha — Dantodbheda, p. 504-505). During dentition (Dantodbheda), all Dhatus and Doshas are stirred; gentle gingival Pratisarana eases eruption while Musta-Bilva checks teething diarrhea without suppressing tooth growth.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Breast milk, boiled water, clean teething hygiene. Apathya: Dirty pacifiers/toys, heavy cow milk.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 2 (p. 504-505); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 11
safety_check: NEVER use honey in infants under 12 months (use cow's Ghee or breast milk instead)

condition_name: Pediatric Memory, Speech Clarity & Immunity Enhancement (Bala Medhya & Lehana)
remedy_name: Brahmi-Vacha-Shankhapushpi Ghrita (Classical Pediatric Medhya Ghrita)
remedy_text: Give 2-5 ml (1/2 to 1 tsp) of pure cow's Ghee medicated with Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri), Mandukaparni (Centella asiatica), Shankhapushpi, and Vacha (Acorus calamus — in tiny pinch dose) mixed in warm milk every morning.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 1 Balopacharaniya, p. 498-499 & Ch. 49 Rasayana, p. 708) and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 28). Enhances Dhi (learning), Dhriti (retention), Smriti (recall), and Vak-shuddhi (speech clarity) in growing children.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cow's milk, ghee, almonds, Amla. Apathya: Junk food, excessive screen time.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 1 (p. 498-499) & Ch. 49 (p. 708); Madanapala Nighantu (p. 28); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8
safety_check: 100% Safe for children and adults

condition_name: Vertigo, Dizziness, Fainting & Syncope Tendency (Bhrama & Murchha)
remedy_name: Duralambhadi Kwath & Amalaki-Kharjura-Draksha Cooling Mantha
remedy_text: 1) Immediate Cooling Energy Drink (Mantha): Mash 4-5 soaked dates (Kharjura), 10 soaked black raisins (Draksha/Munakka), 3 gm Amla powder, and 250 mg Elaichi powder in 150 ml cool water or milk with 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee; drink slowly. 2) Classical Decoction: Drink 20 ml decoction of Yavasaka/Duralambha, Guduchi, Shunthi, and Pathya with Ghee.
