ayurvedic_note: In Chakradatta (Murchhadhikara — Bhrama Chikitsa, p. 98-99) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Nidanasthana Ch. 6, p. 270: 'Chakravad bhramate deho bhramah pittanilatmakah'), Bhrama (spinning vertigo) arises from Rajas, Pitta, and Vata; Madhura-Sheeta-Snigdha formulations with Ghee, Amla, Draksha, and Kharjura stabilize Prana Vata and Sadhaka Pitta.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Lying down in a cool ventilated room, milk with ghee, pomegranate, dates, coconut water. Apathya: Sudden standing up, fasting, hot sun, excess tea/coffee.
source: Chakradatta Murchhadhikara (p. 98-99); Ashtanga Sangraha Nidanasthana Ch. 6 (p. 270)
safety_check: Note: Sudden vertigo with slurred speech, facial weakness, double vision, or chest pain is a RED-TIER STROKE/CARDIAC EMERGENCY! Use home care only for benign/heat/weakness dizziness.

condition_name: Insomnia, Chronic Sleeplessness & Nighttime Anxiety (Anidra / Nidranasha)
remedy_name: Ashwagandha-Jatamansi-Jayphal Warm Milk & Padabhyanga (Foot Massage)
remedy_text: 1) Bedtime Drink: Take 3 gm Ashwagandha powder and a pinch (125-250 mg) of Jayphal (nutmeg) or Jatamansi powder in a cup of warm milk (buffalo or cow milk) with 1 tsp Ghee 30 minutes before bed. 2) External Therapy: Wash feet with warm water and massage the soles and crown of the head (Murdhni Taila) with warm sesame oil or cow's Ghee for 5 minutes before sleeping.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 9 Viruddhanna / Nidra Vijnaniya, p. 68-69: 'Abhyango murdhni tailam cha... nidranashe hitah') and Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS, p. 11). Calms hyperactive Prana Vata and Tarpaka Kapha depletion.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Early light dinner, foot massage with warm ghee, dim lights before sleep. Apathya: Tea/coffee after 4 PM, late-night mobile screen use, daytime sleeping.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 9 (p. 68-69); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 8, 11
safety_check: Avoid Ashwagandha in Pregnancy (use plain warm milk with Ghee and Amla-Takra forehead paste instead)

condition_name: Tinnitus / Ringing in Ears & Age-Related Hearing Weakness (Karnanada, Karnakshweda & Badhirya)
remedy_name: Bilva Taila / Dashamoola-Bala Siddha Taila Karnapurana & Ashwagandha-Sariva
remedy_text: 1) External (Only if NO ear discharge/perforation): Instill 2-3 lukewarm drops of classical Bilva Taila (sesame oil cooked with unripe Bilva pulp, cow's milk, and Vatahara herbs) into the ear canal once daily, and gently massage around the ear and mastoid with warm sesame oil. 2) Oral: Take 3 gm Ashwagandha and Sariva powder with warm milk.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 22 Karnaroga Pratishedha, p. 579-580: 'Yada tu vayuः shravanam प्रविश्य करोति नादं... बिल्वतैलं परमं हितम्') and Chakradatta (Karnarogachikitsa), Karnanada (tinnitus) is caused by Vata localizing in the auditory nerve channels; Bilva Taila Karnapurana and Vata-brimhana nourish the acoustic pathway.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm oil head/ear massage, cow's ghee, milk, protecting ears from loud noise and cold hill wind. Apathya: Earphones at high volume, dry/cold foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 22 (p. 579-580); Chakradatta Karnarogachikitsa
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IF EAR DISCHARGE (PUS/FLUID) OR PERFORATION IS PRESENT

condition_name: Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media / Ear Discharge (Karnasrava & Putikarna)
remedy_name: Oral Triphala Guggulu + Sarivadi Vati & Dry Astringent Ear Wick Care (Pramarjana)
remedy_text: When pus or fluid is discharging from the ear (Karnasrava): 1) NEVER instill household oil or juice drops into a discharging ear! 2) Gently dry-mop the outer ear with a sterile cotton wick (Karna-pramarjana). 3) Oral Therapy: Take Triphala Guggulu (1 tablet twice daily) and Panchatikta/Nimba-Guduchi decoction (20 ml twice daily) to dry up purulent discharge from within, and consult the PHC doctor for otoscopic evaluation.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 22, p. 581), Putikarna and Karnasrava require Shodhana, Kleda-shoshana (drying purulent exudate via Tikta-Kashaya drugs like Triphala, Nimba, Panchavalkala, and Guggulu), and avoiding unsterile oily drops when the tympanic membrane is perforated.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Keeping water out of the ear during bath (use Vaseline-coated cotton plug on outer concha), warm dry food. Apathya: Swimming, head bath in rivers/ponds, curd, banana, sour foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 22 (p. 581); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Karnarogadhikara
safety_check: Safe oral therapy for EarDischarge; avoid Triphala Guggulu in Pregnancy (use Guduchi-Amalaki decoction instead)

condition_name: Acute Conjunctivitis, Red/Sticky Eyes & Stye (Abhishyanda & Anjananamika)
remedy_name: Triphala-Lodhra Sterile Eye Wash (Aschyotana/Seka) & Warm Sweda (for Stye)
remedy_text: 1) For Red/Sticky Conjunctivitis (Abhishyanda): Boil 1 tsp Triphala powder and a pinch of Lodhra or Daruharidra in 200 ml water for 5 minutes, cool completely, filter 3 times through sterile cloth, and gently wash the closed/open eye 3-4 times daily. Apply a paste of Haridra, Lodhra, and Alum (Sphatika) OUTSIDE over the closed eyelids (Bidalaka — never inside the eye). 2) For Stye (Anjananamika): Apply gentle warm dry cloth compress over the eyelid nodule.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 19 Abhishyanda Pratishedha, p. 566-568 & Ch. 11 Vartmaroga Pratishedha, p. 536) and Madanapala Nighantu (p. 20, 23). Reduces conjunctival hyperemia and mucopurulent discharge.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Wearing dark glasses outdoors, washing hands frequently, light diet. Apathya: Rubbing eyes, sharing handkerchiefs/towels, curd, head bath.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 11 (p. 536) & Ch. 19 (p. 566-568); Madanapala Nighantu (p. 20, 23)
safety_check: Seek immediate PHC ophthalmic care if vision is blurred, cornea is hazy, or severe photophobia/pain is present

condition_name: Acute Fever Headache, Migraine & Sun-Induced Vascular Headache (Pittaja Shiroroga & Ardhavabhedaka)
remedy_name: Godanti Bhasma (Purified Gypsum Calx) with Misri/Ghee & Chandana-Ushira Lepa
remedy_text: 1) Classical Oral: Take 250-500 mg purified Godanti Bhasma mixed with 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee and 1/2 tsp Misri (sugar) or warm milk/tea twice daily. 2) External Forehead Lepa: Apply a cool paste of Chandana (sandalwood), Ushira (Khus), and Amla ground in rose water or buttermilk over the forehead and temples.
ayurvedic_note: In Rasatarangini and Ayurvedaprakasha (Upadhatu/Sudha Varga), Godanti Bhasma is Sheeta Virya, Pitta-shamaka, Jwaraghna, and Shirahshoolaghna—acting as a safe natural analgesic and antipyretic for vascular migraine and high-temperature headaches without causing gastric ulcers.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Rest in a cool dark room, milk, ghee, coconut water. Apathya: Hot sun, skipping meals, spicy/fermented foods.
source: Ayurvedaprakasha Sudha/Upadhatu Varga; Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 28 (p. 604)
safety_check: Safe in Gastritis and Ulcer (where NSAIDs are contraindicated); omit Misri in Diabetes

condition_name: Excessive Thirst, Dry Mouth & Heat Exhaustion (Trishna & Daha)
remedy_name: Kharjuradi Mantha (Dates, Raisins, Pomegranate & Tamarind/Amla Rehydration Drink)
remedy_text: Soak and mash equal parts (10 gm each) of deseeded Kharjura (dates), Draksha (black raisins), Dadima (pomegranate seeds), Kokam/Tintidika or Amla, and Parushaka (Falsa) in 300 ml cool boiled water with a pinch of roasted Jeera and rock salt; strain and sip frequently.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Trishnadhikara & Madatyayadhikara, p. 97-99) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 8-9, p. 371-373: 'Kharjuramridvikavrikshamladadimaparushakaih... manthah') for instantly relieving severe dehydration, dry tongue (Talushosha), heat exhaustion, and alcohol hangover (Madatyaya).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cool shade, coconut water, sweet seasonal fruits. Apathya: Alcohol, sun exposure, spicy salty food.
source: Chakradatta Trishnadhikara & Madatyayadhikara (p. 97-99); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 8-9 (p. 371-373)
safety_check: Avoid in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains dates/raisins — use Shadanga Paniya or lemon-salt water instead)

condition_name: Generalized Burning Sensation, Heat Prickles & Feverish Burning (Sarvanga Daha)
remedy_name: Usheerasava / Chandanasava & Hriveradi Cooling Bath/Sponging
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Take 15-20 ml Usheerasava (prepared from Ushira/Khus, Balaka/Hrivera, Padma, Gambhari, Nilotpala, Priyangu, Padmaka, Lodhra, Manjishtha, Dhanvayasa, Patha, Kiratatikta, Nyagrodha, Udumbara, Shati, Parpataka, कमल, Patola, Kanchanara, Jambu, Mocharasa, Draksha, Dhataki) mixed with equal cool water twice daily after meals. 2) External: Sponge body with cool water infused with Ushira (Khus) and Chandana.
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Raktapittadhikara, p. 222) and Chakradatta (Dahadhikara, p. 100-101). Cools Pitta-Rakta throughout the body, relieves burning urination, epistaxis, and summer heat intolerance.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Coconut water, cucumber, ash gourd, cotton clothing. Apathya: Hot sun, chili, sour curd, alcohol.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Raktapittadhikara (p. 222); Chakradatta Dahadhikara (p. 100-101)
safety_check: Avoid sugar-fermented Asava in uncontrolled Diabetes (use unsweetened Ushira-Dhania Hima instead)

condition_name: Persistent Bilious or Mucoid Vomiting & Gastritis (Pittaja/Kaphaja Chhardi)
remedy_name: Eladi Churna / Bilvadi Sheeta Kashaya & Mayurapiccha/Shankha Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Eladi Churna: Mix equal parts of Ela (Green Cardamom), Lavanga (Clove), Nagakesara, Kolamajja (Jujube/Ber seed kernel), Laja (parched paddy), Priyangu, Musta, Chandana, and Pippali; lick 1-2 gm mixed with honey and sugar in small frequent doses. 2) Bilvadi Kwath: Sip cooled decoction of Bilva bark/leaves and Guduchi with 1 tsp honey.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Chhardyadhikara, p. 95: 'Eladichurnam... chhardim hanti') and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 8, p. 366). Pacifies upward-moving Udana Vata and irritated stomach Pitta.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Laja Manda (parched rice water), pomegranate, lemon aroma. Apathya: Solid heavy meals until vomiting stops.
source: Chakradatta Chhardyadhikara (p. 95); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 8 (p. 366)
safety_check: Note: Persistent vomiting (>24h or inability to keep fluids down / sunken eyes) is a YELLOW-TIER dehydration alert requiring ORS and PHC antiemetic care!

condition_name: Acute Gastroenteritis, Food Poisoning & Cholera-like Cramping (Visuchika & Alasaka)
remedy_name: Lavangadi / Karpuradi ORS Support & Parshni-Daha / Mustadi Pachana
remedy_text: 1) Immediate Rehydration: Give Nimbu-Lavana-Sharkara ORS water or Laja Manda (salted parched rice gruel) boiled with Dhania and Shunthi in continuous small sips. 2) Oral Ama-Pachana: Give 20 ml decoction of Musta, Shunthi, Dhania, and Laung (Clove). Apply warm mustard oil with rock salt massage over calf muscles if leg cramps (Pindikodveshtana) occur.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Agnimandyadhikara — Visuchika Chikitsa, p. 63) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Agnimandyadhikara, p. 228). Visuchika (simultaneous vomiting and diarrhea with pricking pain and muscle cramps from severe Ama) requires continuous hydration and Ama digestion.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: ORS, rice gruel (Manda/Peya), boiled water. Apathya: Solid food, milk, raw water.
source: Chakradatta Agnimandyadhikara (p. 63); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadhikara (p. 228)
safety_check: YELLOW/RED TIER ALERT: Profuse watery diarrhea + vomiting with dehydration (dry tongue, no urine, lethargy) requires immediate PHC IV fluids / ORS!

condition_name: Stomatitis, Pharyngitis, Tonsillitis, Spongy Gums & Halitosis (Mukharoga & Kantharoga)
remedy_name: Khadiradi Vati & Irimedadi Taila Kavala (Medicated Oil Pulling/Gargle)
remedy_text: 1) Lozenge: Slowly suck 1 tablet of Khadiradi Vati (prepared from Khadira sara, Arimeda bark, Karpura, Javitri, Kankola, Jatiphala, Lavanga, Ela, Amalaki, Lodhra,Manjishtha, Lajjalu) 3-4 times daily. 2) Gargle / Oil Pulling (Kavala): Swish 5-10 ml of Irimedadi Taila (or warm Triphala-Sphatika water) in the mouth for 3-5 minutes and spit out twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 26 Mukharoga Pratishedha, p. 597-601) and Chakradatta (Mukharogachikitsa). Khadira (Acacia catechu) is declared in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 2, p. 16) as the supreme astringent for tightening gums, healing oral ulcers, and clearing throat infections.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Brushing twice daily, warm water gargles. Apathya: Tobacco, pan masala, sticky sweets, very hot/cold drinks.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 2 (p. 16) & Uttarasthana Ch. 26 (p. 597-601); Chakradatta Mukharogachikitsa
safety_check: Topical oral care — 100% safe across all adult populations including Diabetes and Hypertension

condition_name: Acute Tonsillitis, Uvulitis, Bleeding Gums & Minor Cuts (Kanthashundi & Raktasrava)
remedy_name: Shuddha Sphatika (Purified Alum / Phitkari) Warm Water Gargle
remedy_text: Dissolve a small pinch (250-500 mg) of Shuddha Sphatika Bhasma (heated/purified Alum / Phitkari) and 1/4 tsp Sendha Namak (rock salt) in a glass (200 ml) of warm water. Gargle thoroughly for 2-3 minutes and spit out (do not swallow) 3 times daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ayurvedaprakasha (Ch. 7 Upadhatu/Uparasa Varga — Sphatika, p. 101: 'Sphatika tuvara... kantharogaharah') and Bhaishajya Ratnavali, purified Sphatika is strongly Kashaya (astringent), Shothahara (shrinks swollen tonsils and uvula), and Raktastambhana (stops gum bleeding immediately).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm liquid diet, spitting out gargle water. Apathya: Swallowing alum water, cold drinks, sour curd.
source: Ayurvedaprakasha Ch. 7 (p. 101); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Mukharogadhikara
safety_check: For GARGLE AND SPIT ONLY (do not swallow); safe for all adults

condition_name: Chronic Productive Cough, Asthma & Mucus Plugging (Kaphapradhana Kasa & Shwasa)
remedy_name: Shringyadi Churna & Pushkaramooladi Churna with Honey
remedy_text: Mix equal parts of Karkatashringi (Pistacia integerrima / Kakdasingi), Trikatu (Shunthi, Maricha, Pippali), Triphala, Kantakari, Bharangi, Pushkaramoola, and Saindhava. Take 1-2 gm mixed with 1 tsp honey and warm water twice or thrice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Hikka-Shwasadhikara, p. 89-90: Shringyadi Churna) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 6). Karkatashringi and Pushkaramoola liquefy viscid bronchial plugs and relieve intercostal chest tightness.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, Kulattha (Gahat) soup, steam inhalation. Apathya: Cold air, curd, heavy meals at night.
source: Chakradatta Hikka-Shwasadhikara (p. 89-90); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 6
safety_check: Contraindicated in Infants <1 year (Honey) and active Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Dry Hacking Cough, Hoarseness & Bronchial Irritation (Vata-Pitta Kasa)
remedy_name: Eladi Gutika (Classical Cardamom-Pippali-Licorice-Dates Pill)
remedy_text: Prepared from Ela (Cardamom - 1/2 part), Patra (1/2 part), Tvak (1/2 part), Pippali (2 parts), Sitopala/Misri (4 parts), Yashtimadhu (4 parts), Kharjura/Dates (4 parts), and Draksha/Raisins (4 parts) triturated with honey into 500 mg pills. Suck or chew 1 pill slowly 3-4 times daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Raktapittadhikara, p. 85-86) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali for soothing dry hacking cough, throat irritation, voice loss (Swarabheda), thirst, and blood-streaked sputum (Kshataja Kasa) without heating Pitta.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm milk with ghee, pomegranate, dates. Apathya: Spicy, dry, cold foods.
source: Chakradatta Raktapittadhikara (p. 85-86); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Raktapittadhikara (p. 215)
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains Misri/Dates/Raisins), Hypertension (contains Yashtimadhu), and Infants <1 year (Honey)

condition_name: Chronic Cough with Weakness & Night Fever (Kshayaja Kasa & Rajayakshma Support)
remedy_name: Kushmanda Avaleha / Vasa-Kushmanda Khanda (Ash Gourd Rejuvenative Linctus)
remedy_text: Prepared from mature Kushmanda (Benincasa hispida / Ash gourd / Petha) pulp cooked in cow's Ghee and sugar with Pippali, Shunthi, Jiraka, Dhanyaka, Patra, Ela, Maricha, Tvak, and Honey. Take 5-10 gm twice daily with warm milk.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Raktapittadhikara, p. 86) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (p. 216-217). Nourishes depleted lung parenchyma (Urah-kshata), relieves chronic cough with chest pain, hyperacidity, and emaciation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, ash gourd, pomegranate. Apathya: Dry, spicy food, smoking, physical exhaustion.
source: Chakradatta Raktapittadhikara (p. 86); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Raktapittadhikara (p. 216-217)
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes and Infants <1 year

condition_name: Chronic Hyperacidity, Bile Reflux,Burning Chest & Headache (Urdhwaga Amlapitta)
remedy_name: Bhunimbadi Kwath / Vasadi Kwath (Sugar-Free Classical Amlapitta Decoction)
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from equal parts of Bhunimba (Kiratatikta), Nimba bark, Patola leaves, Triphala, Vasa leaves, Guduchi (Giloy), and Parpataka. Drink cooled with 1 tsp honey (or plain if diabetic) twice daily before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Amlapittachikitsa) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Amlapittadhikara). Unlike sugar-heavy Avipattikara Churna, this Tikta-Kashaya decoction clears sour-bitter Pitta-Kapha reflux in diabetic and hypertensive patients safely.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Barley, old rice, bitter gourd, pointed gourd (Parwal), pomegranate. Apathya: Chili, sour curd, fermented idli/dosa, tea/coffee.
source: Chakradatta Amlapittachikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Amlapittadhikara
safety_check: SAFE IN DIABETES AND HYPERTENSION; avoid in Pregnancy (contains Vasa/Haritaki)

condition_name: Gastritis, Heartburn, Calcium Deficiency & Pregnancy Heartburn (Amlapitta & Asthikshaya)
remedy_name: Pravala Pishti / Mukta Shukti Bhasma with Amla & Rose Water/Milk
remedy_text: Take 125-250 mg of Pravala Pishti (triturated coral calcium with rose water) or Mukta Shukti Bhasma (pearl oyster shell calx) mixed with 2 gm Amla powder and 1 tsp Ghee/milk or honey twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ayurvedaprakasha (Upadhatu/Sudha Varga) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Pravala and Mukta Shukti are Madhura, Sheeta, deep antacids (Amlapittahara), and provide bioavailable natural calcium.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, coconut water, pomegranate, sweet fruits. Apathya: Spicy, sour, fried foods.
source: Ayurvedaprakasha Sudha Varga; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Amlapittadhikara
safety_check: 100% Safe in Pregnancy, Gastritis, Peptic Ulcer, Diabetes, and Hypertension

condition_name: Post-Prandial Heaviness, Distension & Indigestion of Fatty/Heavy Foods (Snigdha Ajirna)
remedy_name: Ushnodaka (Boiled Reduced Warm Water) & Manda/Yusha Anupana Protocol
remedy_text: Boil drinking water until reduced to half (Ardhavashishta Ushnodaka) or three-fourths, keep in a thermos, and sip warm in small quantities throughout the day. If indigestion was caused by oily/ghee/fried food, sip warm lemon-barley water or Takra (buttermilk).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 6 Dravadravya Vijnaniya, p. 35-36: 'Dipanam pachanam kanthyam laghu ushnam bastishodhanam...'), boiled warm water (Ushnodaka) alone is a potent medicine that digests Ama, clears Kapha-Vata, relieves hiccough, bloating, cough, and new fever without any herb contraindications.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Sipping warm water during meals (Madhye-ambupana maintains equilibrium), eating light. Apathya: Drinking ice-cold water immediately after oily meals.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 6 (p. 35-36); Chakradatta Agnimandyadhikara (p. 58)
safety_check: 100% Safe for all ages, pregnant women, infants, and all comorbidities

condition_name: Generalized Anasarca, Renal/Hepatic Edema & Anemia with Swelling (Pandu-Shotha)
remedy_name: Punarnavadi Mandura & Punarnavasava
remedy_text: 1) Classical Tablet: Punarnavadi Mandura (prepared from Punarnava, Trivrit, Trikatu, Vidanga, Devadaru, Chitraka, Kushtha, Haridra, Daruharidra, Triphala, Danti, Chavya, Indrayava, Pippalimoola, Musta, and purified Mandura Bhasma cooked in Gomutra) — take 1-2 tablets (250-500 mg) with buttermilk twice daily. 2) Liquid: Punarnavasava (15-20 ml with equal water after meals).
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Shothadhikara & Pandurogadhikara, p. 155, 166) and Chakradatta (Pandurogadhikara, p. 66). Simultaneously corrects severe iron-deficiency anemia (Pandu), reduces systemic fluid retention (Shotha), and improves hepatic and renal clearance.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Salt-free or low-salt diet, barley, old rice, buttermilk, Punarnava greens. Apathya: Table salt, curd, heavy fried food, daytime sleep.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Pandurogadhikara (p. 155) & Shothadhikara (p. 166, 179); Chakradatta (p. 66)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (contains Trivrit/Danti/Vidanga); any generalized edema requires PHC renal/cardiac evaluation
keywords: शरीर में सूजन और खून की कमी

condition_name: Lumbar Spondylosis, Chronic Low Back Ache & Muscle Spasm (Katishoola & Katigraha)
remedy_name: Dashamoola-Eranda Kwath & Kati Basti / Warm Sesame-Saindhava Massage
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Boil 5 gm Dashamoola and 3 gm Eranda moola (Ricinus communis root) with 1 gm Shunthi in 160 ml water down to 40 ml; add 1/2 tsp castor oil or a pinch of Yavakshara/Hing and drink warm twice daily. 2) External: Massage lower back with warm sesame oil (Til taila) or Vishgarbha/Mahanarayana Taila followed by a hot water bag or warm salt bolus (Lavanapottali Sweda).
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Vatavyadhyadhikara). Eranda moola is declared in Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Erandamoolam vrishyavataharanam') as the #1 root for low back and pelvic Vata pain (Kati-basti-shoola).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Firm mattress, warm water, garlic, fenugreek, Bhujangasana (gentle cobra stretch once acute spasm subsides). Apathya: Bending forward to lift heavy loads, cold wind exposure, rajma/chana.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98); Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (oral castor oil); topical warm sesame oil massage is safe

condition_name: High-Altitude Cold Exposure, Frostnip/Chilblains & Cold Extremities (Sheetavata &Jadya)
remedy_name: Warm Sarshapa Taila-Saindhava-Lahsun Rub & Trikatu-Tulsi Tea
remedy_text: For swollen, red, itchy fingers/toes from winter hill cold (chilblains): 1) Soak hands/feet in warm water boiled with Neem leaves or Haldi and rock salt (never use direct high heat on numb skin), pat dry, and massage gently with Mustard oil (Sarshapa taila) boiled with crushed Lahsun (garlic), Ajvain, and Haldi, then wear warm woolen socks/gloves. 2) Drink warm Tulsi-Adrak-Dalchini herbal tea.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 4 Ritucharya — Hemanta/Shishira, p. 25 & Ch. 6 Taila Varga, p. 42), Sarshapa Taila (mustard oil) is Katu, Ushna, Tikshna, and Kapha-Vata-Kandughna, restoring microcirculation and relieving cold-induced swelling and itching.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Keeping extremities warm and dry, sesame/mustard oil massage, warm soups. Apathya: Putting freezing hands/feet directly against fire/heater, washing with icy water.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 4 (p. 25) & Ch. 6 (p. 42); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 1, 5, 9, 15, 25
safety_check: 100% Safe external application for winter hill care

condition_name: Insect Bites, Bee/Wasp Stings & Nettle/Plant Rash (Keeta Damsha & Vrischika/Alarka Visha)
remedy_name: Tulsi-Haldi-Ghee Lepa & Saindhava-Nimbu / Dashanga Topical Paste
remedy_text: 1) Immediate First Aid: Remove any visible stinger gently, wash with soap/Neem water, and apply a thick paste of crushed fresh Tulsi leaves mixed with Haldi (turmeric) powder and pure cow's Ghee (or Shirish seed + Haridra + Saindhava paste). 2) Oral: Take 1-2 gm Haldi powder with warm milk or 10 ml Tulsi juice.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 43 Keeta-Luta Pratishedha, p. 674-678) and Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS, p. 9, 25), Surasa (Tulsi), Haridra, Shirisha, and Ghrita neutralize local insect venom (Vishaghna), burning (Daha), and wheals (Shotha).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cool compress, rest. Apathya: Scratching the bite site, hot/spicy/fermented foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 43 (p. 674-678); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 9 (Haldi) & p. 25 (Tulsi)
safety_check: RED-TIER WARNING: Any snakebite, scorpion sting in a child, or insect sting causing lip/throat swelling, wheezing, or dizziness (Anaphylaxis) requires IMMEDIATE 108 / PHC hospital transfer!

condition_name: Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Breast Tenderness & Menstrual Irregularity (Artavavyapad)
remedy_name: Kumaryasava / Shatavari-Jeeraka-Dhania Yoga
remedy_text: 1) Household Yoga: Take 3 gm Shatavari powder, 1 gm roasted Jeera powder, and 2 gm Dhania powder with warm milk or water twice daily for 7 days before menses. 2) Classical (Non-Pregnant): Kumaryasava (prepared from Aloe vera juice, Lauha, Trikatu, Triphala, Chaturjata) 15 ml with equal water after meals.
ayurvedic_note: In Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Strirogadhikara & Yakritplihadhikara) and Madanapala Nighantu (p. 18), Shatavari and Kumari regulate Apana Vata and Ranjaka/Pachaka Pitta, relieving premenstrual bloating, mood swings, and dysmenorrhea.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm freshly cooked diet, sesame, pomegranate, gentle walking. Apathya: Excess salt, caffeine, cold drinks.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Strirogadhikara; Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 18)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (Kumaryasava); Shatavari-Jeera-Dhania with milk is safe
keywords: मासिक धर्म से पहले दर्द और चिड़चिड़ापन

condition_name: Post-Illness Weakness, Elderly Frailty & Loss of Muscle Mass (Jara & Dhatukshaya)
remedy_name: Bala-Ashwagandha-Vidarikanda Ksheerapaka & Abhyanga
remedy_text: Boil 3 gm Bala (Sida cordifolia) root powder, 3 gm Ashwagandha powder, and 3 gm Vidarikanda (Pueraria tuberosa) powder in 150 ml milk and 300 ml water until 150 ml milk remains; strain, add 1 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp Misri, and drink warm once daily. Pair with daily warm sesame oil body massage (Abhyanga).
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 18 & 22: Bala & Vidarikanda) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 13 Agryasangraha, p. 98: 'Bala sangrahaniyabalavataharanam'), Bala, Vidarikanda, and Ashwagandha build Mamsa and Ojas and combat age-related sarcopenia and Vata frailty.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Milk, ghee, soaked almonds, dates, moong soup. Apathya: Dry, bitter, astringent foods, fasting.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 13 (p. 98); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 18, 22)
safety_check: Omit Misri in Diabetes; avoid Ashwagandha in Pregnancy (Bala + Vidarikanda + Milk is safe)

condition_name: Muscle Cramps, Calf Spasms & Restless Legs (Pindikodveshtana & Padaharsha)
remedy_name: Mahanarayana / Til Taila-Saindhava Calf Massage & Nimbu-Lavana-Sharkara /Milk-Ghee
remedy_text: 1) Immediate Relief & Prevention: Drink a glass of Nimbu-Pani with a pinch of rock salt and sugar (if cramps follow sweating/field work) OR warm milk with 1 tsp cow's Ghee and 2 soaked dates/munakka at bedtime (if nocturnal Vata cramps). 2) External: Massage calves from ankle upward with warm sesame oil or Mahanarayana Taila before sleep.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 19 Doshabhediya, p. 122), Pindikodveshtana (calf muscle cramping) is one of the 80 Nanatmaja Vata disorders caused by Dhatu-kshaya (electrolyte/fluid depletion) or Vata rukshata; Madhura-Amla-Lavana Rasas and Snehana-Abhyanga immediately relax muscle spasm.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Adequate hydration, milk, ghee, banana, pomegranate. Apathya: Dehydration, excess tea/coffee, cold floor exposure.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 19 (p. 122); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 8, 21
safety_check: 100% Safe across all patients including Pregnancy

condition_name: Severe Anorexia, Coated Tongue & Salivation (Kaphaja Arochaka)
remedy_name: Yavani Shadavama (Classical Ajvain-Tamarind-Pomegranate Appetizer Powder)
remedy_text: Composed of Yavani (Ajvain), Tintidika (Tamarind/Kokam), Shunthi, Amlavetasa, Dadima (pomegranate seeds), Badara (sour jujube), Dhanyaka, Sauvarchala/Kala Namak, Jeeraka, Tvak, Pippali, Maricha, and Sharkara. Place 1-2 gm on the tongue before meals twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 7, p. 364) and Chakradatta (Arochakadhikara, p. 93-94) for restoring taste perception (Rasa-bodhana), clearing tongue coating, and relieving chronic anorexia, cough, and Grahani.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Tongue scraping, warm water, pomegranate. Apathya: Cold, heavy, sweet foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 7 (p. 364); Chakradatta Arochakadhikara (p. 93-94)
safety_check: Omit sugar in Diabetes; omit black salt in severe Hypertension

condition_name: Taste Loss & Dry Mouth in Fever or Pitta Disorders (Pittaja/Vataja Arochaka)
remedy_name: Dadima-Sharkara-Saindhava Kavala (Pomegranate Mouth Hold/Rinse)
remedy_text: Mix 10 ml fresh sweet-sour Dadima (Anar/pomegranate) juice with a pinch of Saindhava Lavana (rock salt), roasted Jeera powder, and 1/2 tsp honey or sugar; hold and swish inside the mouth (Kavala-graha) for 2-3 minutes before meals.
ayurvedic_note: Directly taught in Chakradatta (Arochakadhikara, p. 93) and CCRAS Ayurvedic Home Remedies (p. 3: 'to hold inside mouth for sometime before food'). Immediately stimulates salivary glands and cleanses the oral mucosa.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Pomegranate, fresh warm meals. Apathya: Stale food.
source: Chakradatta Arochakadhikara (p. 93); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 3 (Anar)
safety_check: 100% Safe for all adult patients
keywords: बुखार के बाद मुंह कड़वा होना

condition_name: Bleeding Dysentery & Ulcerative Proctitis (Raktatisara)
remedy_name: Kutaja-Dadima-Ushira-Mocharasa Kwath with Goat/Cow Milk & Tandulodaka
remedy_text: Take 2-3 gm powder of Indrayava (Kutaja seeds), Bilva pulp, Lodhra, Mocharasa (Salmalia malabarica gum), and Kamala kesara (lotus stamens) with Tandulodaka (washed rice water) and 1 tsp honey/sugar thrice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Atisarachikitsa — Raktatisara, p. 33-34) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara, p. 284). Arrests intestinal mucosal bleeding (Raktastambhana) while cooling Pitta.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Rice water, pomegranate juice, boiled cooled milk diluted with water. Apathya: Spicy, hot, sour, salty foods.
source: Chakradatta Atisarachikitsa (p. 33-34); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara (p. 284)
safety_check: YELLOW-TIER WARNING: Frank blood in stool with fever or dizziness requires PHC stool examination and clinical evaluation!

condition_name: Bleeding Hemorrhoids & Anal Fissure Bleeding (Raktarsha)
remedy_name: Kutajavaleha / Bolabaddha Rasa & Nagakesara-Navanita (Butter) Yoga
remedy_text: Take 1-2 gm fine powder of Nagakesara (Mesua ferrea stamens) or Lajjalu/Samanga mixed with 1 tsp fresh unsalted butter (Navanita) and 1/2 tsp Misri (rock candy) twice daily; OR take 5 gm Kutajavaleha twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 Raktarsha Chikitsa, p. 386: 'Navanitatilah prayogah... nagakesaram navanitam sharkara cha') and Chakradatta (Arshachikitsa, p. 52-53), Nagakesara with fresh butter and sugar is the specific classical hemostatic for bleeding piles.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Pomegranate, buttermilk, old rice, fresh butter, Amla. Apathya: Chili, garlic, hing, alcohol, straining.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 10 (p. 386); Chakradatta Arshachikitsa (p. 52-53)
safety_check: Omit Misri in Diabetes; 100% safe in Pregnancy and Hypertension

condition_name: Severe Colic, Epigastric Spasm & Indigestion (Udara Shoola & Visuchika)
remedy_name: Shankha Vati / Mahashankha Vati (Classical Antispasmodic & Digestive Tablet)
remedy_text: Under Vaidya supervision: Take 1 tablet (250 mg) of Shankha Vati (prepared from Tamarind bark ash / Chincha kshara, Panchalavana, Shankha Bhasma, Hingu, Trikatu, triturated in lemon juice) with lukewarm water after meals for acute spasmodic abdominal pain and gas.
ayurvedic_note: Documented in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Agnimandyadhikara, p. 236-237) and Chakradatta (Shooladhikara). Combines antispasmodic Hingu-Trikatu with antacid Shankha Bhasma to relieve severe colic and Grahani rapidly.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, buttermilk, light gruel. Apathya: Heavy pulses, cold drinks.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Agnimandyadhikara (p. 236-237)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Pregnancy and uncontrolled Hypertension (contains Panchalavana)

condition_name: Chronic Bronchitis, Emphysema & Elderly Productive Cough (Kaphavata Kasa & Shwasa)
remedy_name: Dashamoola Katutraya Kwath (Ten Roots + Trikatu + Vasa Decoction)
remedy_text: Boil 5 gm Dashamoola, 2 gm Trikatu (Shunthi, Maricha, Pippali), and 3 gm Vasa (Adusa) leaves in 160 ml water down to 40 ml. Strain, add 1 tsp honey when lukewarm, and drink twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 4 & 6) and Chakradatta (p. 87-90). Dashamoola pacifies Vata in the chest, Vasa dilates bronchioles, and Trikatu clears thick Kapha sputum—ideal for chronic bronchitis and COPD support (sugar-free when taken without honey).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, horse gram soup, steam inhalation. Apathya: Smoking/chulha smoke, cold air, curd.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 4 & 6; Chakradatta Kasachikitsa (p. 87-90)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Pregnancy (contains Vasa) and Infants <1 year

condition_name: Stubborn Productive Cough & Chest Congestion (Kaphaja Kasa)
remedy_name: Shuddha Tankana Bhasma (Purified Borax) with Honey or Sitopaladi
remedy_text: Under Ayurvedic supervision: Mix 125-250 mg of Shuddha Tankana Bhasma (purified/roasted borax) with 1-2 gm Sitopaladi Churna or Pippali Churna and 1 tsp honey; lick twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: In Ayurvedaprakasha (Ch. 7 Upadhatu/Kshara Varga — Tankana, p. 103: 'Tankanah katu... kaphavishleshano hridyah kasashwasanibarhanah'), purified Tankana is a potent mucolytic (Kapha-vishleshana) that liquefies tenacious bronchial phlegm when ordinary herbal syrups fail.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Lukewarm water, light diet. Apathya: Cold drinks, curd.
source: Ayurvedaprakasha Ch. 7 (p. 103); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kasarogadhikara
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED in Pregnancy, Infants/Young Children, and Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Acute Urticaria, Red Wheals & Burning Skin Rash (Pittaja Shitapitta & Visphota)
remedy_name: Shuddha Gairika (Purified Red Ochre) with Honey/Ghee & Guduchi-Nimba
remedy_text: 1) Oral: Take 250-500 mg Shuddha Swarna Gairika (purified red ochre roasted in cow's Ghee) with 1 gm Haridra powder and 1 tsp honey twice daily. 2) Topical: Apply Shuddha Gairika mixed with coconut oil or Shatadhauta Ghrita over itchy red hives.
ayurvedic_note: In Ayurvedaprakasha (Ch. 7 Upadhatu Varga — Gairika, p. 102: 'Gairikam madhuram sheetam... pittasragdahahikkaghnudardavishavinashanam') and Chakradatta (Shitapittachikitsa), Shuddha Gairika is specifically praised for extinguishing Udarda/Shitapitta (urticaria) and Pitta-Rakta burning.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Old rice, Moong soup, pomegranate. Apathya: Sour, salty, fermented foods, fish, curd.
source: Ayurvedaprakasha Ch. 7 (p. 102); Chakradatta Shitapittachikitsa
safety_check: Use only Ghee-roasted Shuddha Swarna Gairika; avoid honey in infants <1 year

condition_name: Scrotal Swelling, Hydrocele & Inguinal Hernia Support (Vriddhi Roga / Antravriddhi)
remedy_name: Rasna-Eranda-Punarnava Kwath with Castor Oil (Vriddhihara Yoga)
remedy_text: Boil equal parts of Rasna, Yashtimadhu, Guduchi, Eranda moola (castor root), Bala, Gokshura, and Punarnava in water to make 20-30 ml decoction; mix with 5 ml Eranda Taila (castor oil) or Haritaki powder and take warm once daily. Wear a supportive scrotal suspensory/truss.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 15 Vidradhi-Vriddhi Chikitsa, p. 410-411) and Chakradatta (Vriddhichikitsa). Vata-anulomana with Eranda Taila and anti-edematous Punarnava-Gokshura reduce scrotal fluid accumulation and pelvic Vata pressure.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Light warm diet, avoiding straining at stool or heavy lifting. Apathya: Riding, heavy weight lifting, constipating foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 15 (p. 410-411); Chakradatta Vriddhichikitsa
safety_check: RED-TIER WARNING: Any acute, severely painful, irreducible groin/scrotal swelling with vomiting (strangulated hernia or testicular torsion) is a SURGICAL EMERGENCY requiring immediate hospital transfer!

condition_name: Facial Palsy (Bell's Palsy), Trigeminal Neuralgia & Tremors (Ardita & Kampavata)
remedy_name: Mashabaladi Kwath (Black Gram, Bala, Rasna & Ashwagandha Decoction) & Navanita Massage
remedy_text: Boil equal parts of Masha (black gram), Bala root, Eranda moola, Yava (barley), Atmagupta (Kapikacchu / Mucuna pruriens), Rasna, and Ashwagandha to prepare 20-30 ml decoction; add a pinch of Hing and rock salt and take warm twice daily. Massage face/limbs gently with warm Bala Taila or fresh butter (Navanita).
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Vatavyadhichikitsa) and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 23, p. 449). Kapikacchu (natural L-DOPA source), Masha, and Bala nourish cranial and motor nerves in post-acute Bell's palsy and tremors (Kampavata).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Covering face/head from cold wind, warm milk with ghee, soft chewable diet. Apathya: Cold water, exposure to hill wind, daytime sleep.
source: Chakradatta Vatavyadhichikitsa; Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 23 (p. 449)
safety_check: CRITICAL RED-TIER RULE: Any acute onset of facial drooping, arm weakness, or slurred speech MUST be rushed immediately to hospital/108 to rule out acute stroke! Use Mashabaladi only for confirmed chronic/rehabilitative care.

condition_name: Cognitive Decline, Exam Stress, Speech Fluency & Anxiety (Medhakshaya & Chittodvega)
remedy_name: Saraswatarishta / Saraswata Churna & Mandukaparni Swarasa
remedy_text: 1) Fresh Herb: Take 10 ml fresh juice (or 3 gm powder) of Mandukaparni (Centella asiatica / Gotu Kola — grows abundantly near streams in Uttarakhand) or Shankhapushpi paste with warm milk every morning. 2) Classical: Saraswatarishta (15 ml with equal water after meals).
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 49 Rasayana, p. 708: 'Mandukaparnyaः swarasah prayojyah... medhyani rasayanani') and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Rasayanadhikara), Mandukaparni and Shankhapushpi are the premier Medhya Rasayanas for anxiety, memory, and mental fatigue.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cow's milk, ghee, walnuts, almonds, regular Pranayama (Anulom-Vilom & Bhramari). Apathya: Excess caffeine, late-night waking, mental overstrain.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 49 (p. 708); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Rasayanadhikara
safety_check: Mandukaparni and Shankhapushpi with milk are 100% safe across all ages

condition_name: Mild Essential Hypertension Support, Stress Palpitations & Insomnia (Raktagata Vata / Uchcha Raktachapa)
remedy_name: Arjuna-Jatamansi-Sarpagandha/Shankhapushpi Kwath & Lahsun-Takra
remedy_text: Boil 3 gm Arjuna bark, 2 gm Shankhapushpi, 1 gm Jatamansi (Nardostachys jatamansi — native Himalayan herb), and 2 gm Dhania seeds in 160 ml water down to 40 ml; drink twice daily. Also take 1-2 crushed garlic (Lahsun) cloves with buttermilk at lunch.
ayurvedic_note: In Madanapala Nighantu (Karpuradi Varga & Abhayadi Varga, p. 28) and Ashtanga Sangraha, Himalayan Jatamansi and Shankhapushpi calm Vyana-Prana Vata and Sadhaka Pitta, reducing sympathetic vascular tone while Arjuna tones the myocardium.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Low-salt diet, Amla, pomegranate, garlic, daily morning walk, Shavasana. Apathya: Table salt, pickles, papad, anger, smoking, alcohol.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 8 (p. 369); Madanapala Nighantu (p. 28); Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 4, 15
safety_check: Never discontinue prescribed allopathic antihypertensive medicines abruptly; monitor BP at PHC regularly!

condition_name: Dyslipidemia, High Cholesterol, Fatty Liver & Metabolic Syndrome (Medoroga & Avarana Vata)
remedy_name: Triphala-Musta-Vidanga-Guduchi Kwath (Lekhaniya Kwath) & Navaka Guggulu
remedy_text: 1) Daily Decoction: Boil equal parts of Triphala, Musta (Nagarmotha), Guduchi (Giloy), Chitraka, and Shunthi in 160 ml water down to 40 ml; add 1 tsp raw honey when lukewarm and drink every morning on an empty stomach. 2) Classical: Navaka Guggulu or Medohara Guggulu (1-2 tablets twice daily with warm water).
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 24 Dvividhopakramaniya, p. 142-143: 'Guduchibhadramustanam prayogastriphalasya cha... madhuna') and Chakradatta (Sthoulyadhikara). Clears Medodhatvagni-mandya (sluggish lipid metabolism) and scrapes excess Kapha-Meda from blood vessels.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Barley (Yava), old millets (Mandua/Ragi, Jhangora — Uttarakhand millets!), horse gram (Gahat), buttermilk, brisk walking. Apathya: Fried foods, sweets, white rice, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 24 (p. 142-143); Chakradatta Sthoulyadhikara
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy (Guggulu/Haritaki/Chitraka) and Infants <1 year

condition_name: Alopecia, Severe Hair Fall, Premature Greying & Weak Eyesight (Khalitya & Palitya)
remedy_name: Bhringaraja Taila / Mahabhringaraja Taila & Bhringaraja-Amalaki-Krishna Tila Rasayana
remedy_text: 1) Oral Keshya Rasayana: Mix equal parts of Bhringaraja (Eclipta alba) powder, Amalaki (Amla) powder, and black sesame seeds (Krishna Tila); take 3-5 gm with warm milk or honey/ghee every morning. 2) Scalp Massage: Massage scalp gently at night with classical Bhringaraja Taila (sesame/coconut oil cooked with Bhringaraja Swarasa, Manjishtha, Padmaka, Lodhra, Raktachandana, Gairika, Bala, Haridra, Daruharidra, Nagakesara, Priyangu, Yashtimadhu).
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Kshudrarogadhikara & Rasayanadhikara), Bhaishajya Ratnavali, and Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 24: Bhringaraja). Nourishes Asthi Dhatu (whose Mala is hair/Kesha) and cools Pitta in the scalp follicles.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Amla, black sesame, curry leaves, cow's ghee, adequate sleep. Apathya: Excess salt, sour, spicy foods, chemical hair dyes, washing hair with hot water.
source: Chakradatta Kshudrarogadhikara; Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 24); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kshudrarogadhikara
safety_check: 100% Safe for all adult and pediatric groups

condition_name: Scabies, Itchy Pustular Rash & Infected Eczema (Pama & Kachhu)
remedy_name: Arka Taila / Marichadi Taila Topical Application & Neem-Haridra Bath
remedy_text: 1) Medicated Bath: Boil a large handful of fresh Neem leaves and 1 tsp Haldi powder in bath water; wash the body thoroughly. 2) Topical Application: Apply classical Marichadi Taila or Mustard/Coconut oil boiled with Neem leaves, Haridra, Daruharidra, and a pinch of Maricha (black pepper) and purified Gandhaka over all itchy scabies lesions (especially finger webs, wrists, and waist) at night.
ayurvedic_note: From Chakradatta (Kushthachikitsa) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Kushthadhikara). Destroys skin mites/parasites (Krimighna), dries pustular weeping (Kleda-shoshana), and stops intense nocturnal itching (Kandughna).
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Boiling/sun-drying all clothes and bedsheets daily, treating all household contacts simultaneously. Apathya: Sharing clothes/bedding, curd, jaggery, sweets.
source: Chakradatta Kushthachikitsa; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Kushthadhikara; Ayurvedic Home Remedies (CCRAS), p. 9, 13, 20
safety_check: EXTERNAL APPLICATION ONLY — Avoid broken/raw bleeding skin and keep away from eyes/genitals

condition_name: Renal/Biliary/Intestinal Spasmodic Colic & Bloating (Vata-Kapha Shoola & Tunni)
remedy_name: Tumbarvadi Churna (Uttarakhand Timru / Zanthoxylum alatum Carminative Powder)
remedy_text: Composed of Tumbaru (Zanthoxylum armatum / Timru fruit — iconic medicinal shrub of Garhwal & Kumaon!), Hingu (ghee-fried), Pushkaramoola, Yavani (Ajvain), Haritaki, and three Lavanas (Saindhava, Sauvarchala, Vida). Take 1-2 gm with warm water or barley decoction twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Shooladhikara, p. 137: 'Tumbarvadi churnam... shoolaghnam') and Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 16, p. 414). Tumbaru (Timru) is Teekshna, Ushna, Deepana, and immediately relieves severe Vata-Kapha abdominal, pelvic, and flank colic as well as toothache.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light gruel, abdominal warm compress. Apathya: Cold water, gas-forming beans.
source: Chakradatta Shooladhikara (p. 137); Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 (p. 414)
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy, Hyperacidity/Peptic Ulcer, and uncontrolled Hypertension

condition_name: Dental Sensitivity, Spongy Gums & Toothache Prevention (Dantaharsha & Dantashoola)
remedy_name: Apamarga / Khadira / Nimba / Tumbaru Dantadhavana & Til-Taila Gandoosha
remedy_text: 1) Herbal Tooth Powder / Twig: Brush gently with a fresh twig or fine powder of Apamarga (Achyranthes aspera / Chirchita), Nimba, Khadira, or Tumbaru (Timru) mixed with a drop of mustard/sesame oil and a pinch of rock salt. 2) For Tooth Sensitivity to Cold/Sour (Dantaharsha): Hold warm sesame oil (Til Taila) or Dashamoola decoction in the mouth (Gandoosha) for 5 minutes daily.
ayurvedic_note: In Ashtanga Sangraha (Sutrasthana Ch. 3 Dinacharya, p. 16 & Uttarasthana Ch. 26 Mukharoga Pratishedha, p. 595: 'Dantaharshe tilatailam... koshnam dharayet'), warm sesame oil Gandoosha pacifies Vata in the dental nerve endings and eliminates tooth sensitivity.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Daily warm sesame oil pulling, rinsing mouth after every meal. Apathya: Very cold ice water or extremely sour foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Sutrasthana Ch. 3 (p. 16) & Uttarasthana Ch. 26 (p. 595); Madanapala Nighantu (p. 11)
safety_check: 100% Safe topical oral hygiene across all patients

condition_name: Catarrhal Fever with Chest Pain, Cough &Headache (Vatakaphaja Sannipata/Kasa Jwara)
remedy_name: Panchamooli / Dashamooli Kwath with Pippali
remedy_text: Prepare 20-30 ml decoction from Laghu Panchamoola (Shalaparni, Prishniparni, Brihati, Kantakari, Gokshura) or Dashamoola; add 500 mg Pippali powder when warm and take twice daily.
ayurvedic_note: From Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Jwaradhikara v. 61-65, p. 30-31) and Chakradatta (Jwarachikitsa, p. 28). Specifically indicated when fever is accompanied by dry/productive cough, flank/chest ache (Parshvashoola), drowsiness, and Vata-Kapha predominance.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, light gruel (Yavagu). Apathya: Cold air, curd, heavy meals.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Jwaradhikara v. 61-65 (p. 30-31); Chakradatta Jwarachikitsa (p. 28)
safety_check: Safe across adult groups; omit Pippali in active Ulcer

condition_name: Pittaja Diarrhoea with Burning Sensation & Thirst (Pittatisara)
remedy_name: Kiratatikta-Musta-Kutaja-Rasanjana Yoga with Honey
remedy_text: Prepare 20 ml cooled decoction (or 3 gm powder) from equal parts of Kiratatikta, Musta (Nagarmotha), Indrayava (Kutaja seeds), and Rasanjana (Daruharidra extract) or Bilva pulp; take with 1 tsp honey twice or thrice daily.
ayurvedic_note: Described in Chakradatta (Atisarachikitsa, p. 32-33) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Atisaradhikara, p. 282). In Pittatisara (yellow/greenish burning watery stools with thirst and anal burning), hot spices like ginger/chitraka are contraindicated; bitter-astringent cooling Musta, Indrayava, and Bilva check Pitta and bind stools safely.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cooled Laja Manda (parched rice gruel), pomegranate, goat's milk diluted with water. Apathya: Ginger, chili, garlic, sour/hot foods.
source: Chakradatta Atisarachikitsa (p. 32-33); Bhaishajya Ratnavali Atisaradhikara (p. 282)
safety_check: Avoid Rasanjana in Pregnancy (use Musta + Bilva + Anar rind instead); avoid honey in infants <1 year

condition_name: Chronic Bloating, Splenic Enlargement, Piles & Constipation (Gulma, Pliha & Udavarta)
remedy_name: Abhayadi Modaka / Haritaki with Season-Specific Anupana (Ritu-Haritaki)
remedy_text: Take 3-5 gm Haritaki (Terminalia chebula / Harad) powder once daily in the morning with its classical seasonal vehicle (Ritu-Haritaki): with Saindhava (rock salt) in Varsha (Monsoon), Sharkara (sugar) in Sharad (Autumn), Shunthi (dry ginger) in Hemanta (Early Winter), Pippali in Shishira (Late Winter), Madhu (honey) in Vasanta (Spring), and Guda (jaggery) in Grishma (Summer).
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 49 Rasayana, p. 704), Madanapala Nighantu (Abhayadi Varga, p. 2: Haritaki), and Bhaishajya Ratnavali. Haritaki has 5 Rasas (all except Lavana), is Anulomana, Deepana, Medhya, Chakshushya, and rejuvenates the entire GI tract.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Wholesome warm diet, adequate hydration. Apathya: Dry fasting, incompatible foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 49 (p. 704); Madanapala Nighantu Abhayadi Varga (p. 2)
safety_check: STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN PREGNANCY, severe dehydration, and extreme cachexia

condition_name: Chronic Backache, Pelvic Pain, Hernia & Constipation (Katishoola, Vata-Gulma & Vibandha)
remedy_name: Gandharvahastadi Kwath (Castor Root, Chirbilva & Ginger Decoction)
remedy_text: Boil equal parts of Gandharvahasta (Eranda moola / Castor root), Chirbilva (Holoptelea integrifolia), Hutasha (Chitraka), Vishwa (Shunthi), Pathya (Haritaki), Punarnava, Yavasa, and Bhumitala in water to make 20-30 ml decoction; take warm with a pinch of Saindhava and 1/2 tsp jaggery or castor oil before meals.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 Gulma Chikitsa & Vatavyadhi). Restores Apana Vata Anulomana, relieves lower back stiffness, and clears pelvic congestion without harsh purgation.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Warm water, rice gruel, sesame oil massage. Apathya: Cold, dry, gas-producing foods.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Chikitsasthana Ch. 16 & 23
safety_check: Contraindicated in Pregnancy and Diarrhea

condition_name: Cataract Prevention, Presbyopia & Computer Vision Syndrome (Timira & Drishtimandya)
remedy_name: Saptamrita Lauha with Triphala Ghrita & Honey
remedy_text: Take 250-500 mg Saptamrita Lauha (composed of Haritaki, Vibhitaki, Amalaki, Yashtimadhu, and Lauha Bhasma) mixed with 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp Honey (in unequal quantity) at bedtime followed by warm milk.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Chakradatta (Netrarogadhikara & Shooladhikara) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Netrarogadhikara). Nourishes Alochaka Pitta and Tarpaka Kapha in the retina and optic nerve, relieving eye fatigue, night blindness, premature greying, and hyperacidity.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Cow's ghee, Amla, pomegranate, green leafy vegetables, Padabhyanga (foot massage with ghee). Apathya: Sour curds, late-night screen strain.
source: Chakradatta Netrarogadhikara; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Netrarogadhikara
safety_check: Avoid in Pregnancy (contains Haritaki), Hypertension (contains Yashtimadhu), and Infants <1 year

condition_name: Allergic Rhinitis, Post-Nasal Drip & Recurrent Sneezing (Vataja/Kaphaja Pratishyaya)
remedy_name: Vyoshadi Vataka (Classical Trikatu-Trijata-Jaggery Rhinitis Granules/Pills)
remedy_text: Composed of Vyosha (Shunthi, Maricha, Pippali), Talisa patra, Chavya, Tintidika, Amlavetasa, Chitraka, Jeeraka (1 part each), Tvak, Ela, Patra (1/4 part each), and old Jaggery (Guda - 20 parts). Take 3-5 gm twice or thrice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: From Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 24 Nasaroga Pratishedha, p. 588) and Chakradatta (Nasarogachikitsa). Specifically cures Pratishyaya (allergic/infectious rhinitis), Kshavathu (sneezing bouts), sinus heaviness, cough, and hoarseness.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Lukewarm water, covering nose/head in cold wind or dust. Apathya: Cold water, curd, ice cream, daytime sleep.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 24 (p. 588); Chakradatta Nasarogachikitsa
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains Guda) and active Peptic Ulcer

condition_name: Anemia, Postpartum Debility, Loss of Appetite & Chronic Fever in Women (Garbhini/Sutika Pandu & Jwara)
remedy_name: Dhatryarishta / Draksharishta (Classical Amalaki & Raisin Rejuvenative Tonics)
remedy_text: Take 15-20 ml of Dhatryarishta (prepared from 2000 fresh Amla fruits juice, sugar, honey, Pippali, and Dhataki) OR Draksharishta (prepared from black raisins, Tvak, Ela, Patra, Nagakesara, Priyangu, Maricha, Pippali, Vidanga) mixed with equal water twice daily after meals.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Pandurogadhikara, p. 161: Dhatryarishta) and Chakradatta. Restores hemoglobin, relieves chronic fatigue, constipation, cough, and breathlessness.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Wholesome diet, pomegranate, Amla, dates, green gram. Apathya: Sour, spicy, stale foods.
source: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Pandurogadhikara (p. 161); Chakradatta Rajayakshmashikitsa
safety_check: Contraindicated in uncontrolled Diabetes (contains sugar/jaggery); avoid Vidanga-containing Draksharishta during Pregnancy (use fresh Amla/Anar/Munakka instead)

condition_name: Seasonal Detoxification, Immunity & Tridosha Balance (Ritucharya & Swasthavritta Rasayana)
remedy_name: Guduchi-Amalaki-Gokshura Rasayana Churna (Classical 3-Herb Daily Rejuvenative)
remedy_text: Mix equal parts of fine powders of Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia / Giloy stem), Amalaki (Emblica officinalis / Amla fruit rind), and Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris fruit). Take 3-5 gm mixed with 1/2 tsp cow's Ghee and 1 tsp Honey (in unequal quantity) or warm milk once daily in the morning.
ayurvedic_note: Extolled in Ashtanga Sangraha (Uttarasthana Ch. 49 Rasayana Vidhi) and Bhaishajya Ratnavali (Rasayanadhikara). Guduchi balances Tridosha and liver/immunity, Amalaki rejuvenates Pitta/Rakta/Rasayana, and Gokshura strengthens Vata/Mutravaha Srotas—providing a complete, safe daily Rasayana for adult vitality.
pathya_apathya: Pathya: Wholesome Sattvika diet, regular sleep and exercise (Dinacharya). Apathya: Processed/stale foods, suppression of natural urges.
source: Ashtanga Sangraha Uttarasthana Ch. 49; Bhaishajya Ratnavali Rasayanadhikara
safety_check: 100% Safe across adult populations including Hypertension, Gastritis, and Diabetes (take with warm water/milk without honey if diabetic); avoid honey in infants <1 year
